### Create `apps/admin/test/flag.test.tsx`

```tsx
import { SIGNAL_RULES, type CaseView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { marksOf } from "../src/screens/Queue";
import { item, postCase, queueRow } from "./case-fixtures";

/**
 * The flag "possible coordinated reporting" on the console (3d design, sections 7.13, 8.3, 8.4 and 8.9; Task 8),
 * server-rendered: the queue's chip [queue.flag], which moves nothing; the case's chip and line [case.flag] under its
 * header, whose minutes and share are SIGNAL_RULES' and whose counts are the answer's; and [case.sameSource] on an item
 * whose reporter has other open items. Neither names a reporter or a case.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const text = (out: string) =>
  out
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replaceAll("&quot;", '"')
    .replaceAll("&#x27;", "'")
    .replaceAll("&lt;", "<")
    .replaceAll("&gt;", ">")
    .replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const noop = () => undefined;

/** The case page's other props, as the case tests give them. */
const caseProps: Omit<CaseScreenViewProps, "caseId" | "view"> = {
  shownImage: null,
  busy: null,
  notice: null,
  error: null,
  note: "",
  reveal: null,
  onOpenCase: noop,
  onShowImage: noop,
  onShowClearly: noop,
  onHideImage: noop,
  onImageError: noop,
  onSnapshot: noop,
  onNoteChange: noop,
  onNoteSave: noop,
  onRevealOpen: noop,
  onRevealChange: noop,
  onRevealConfirm: noop,
  onRevealClose: noop,
};
/** The case page's text as a reader sees it. */
const page = (view: CaseView): string => text(html(<CaseScreenView {...caseProps} caseId={parseCaseId(view.id)!} view={view} />));

describe("the flag's words (8.3, 8.4)", () => {
  test("[queue.flag] and [case.flag] say what the design says, every number from SIGNAL_RULES or the answer, and name no reporter", () => {
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueFlag).toBe("Possible coordinated reporting");
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseFlag(6, 5)).toBe(
      `Many reports in a short time from accounts that are linked: 6 unanswered reports from 5 accounts within ${SIGNAL_RULES.windowMinutes} minutes, and at least half of those accounts follow one another. This is not a finding: decide the content as always.`,
    );
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.sameSource(3)).toBe("3 other open items from this source.");
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.sameSource(1)).toBe("1 other open item from this source.");
  });

  test("the share is printed from SIGNAL_RULES.linkedShare: half as a word", () => {
    expect(SIGNAL_RULES.linkedShare).toBe(0.5);
    expect(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseFlag(5, 5)).toContain("at least half of those accounts");
  });
});

describe("the queue (8.3)", () => {
  test("a flagged case carries the chip, and it is no key of the order: the marks of a row say what it carries and nothing sorts by them", () => {
    expect(marksOf(queueRow({ flag: { items: 6, reporters: 5 } }))).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueFlag);
    expect(marksOf(queueRow({ flag: null }))).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueFlag);
  });
});

describe("a case (8.4)", () => {
  test("[case.flag] stands under the header with the chip while the answer carries the flag, and not otherwise", () => {
    const flagged = page(postCase({ flag: { items: 7, reporters: 5 } }));
    expect(flagged).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueFlag);
    expect(flagged).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseFlag(7, 5));
    // Under the header: before the evidence.
    expect(flagged.indexOf(AUTOMATION_WORDS.caseFlag(7, 5))).toBeLessThan(flagged.indexOf("Evidence"));
    const plain = page(postCase({ flag: null }));
    expect(plain).not.toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueFlag);
    expect(plain).not.toContain("Many reports in a short time");
  });

  test("[case.sameSource] stands on an item whose reporter has other open items, as a count, and on no other", () => {
    const view = postCase();
    const out = page({ ...view, items: [item({ ...view.items[0]!, sameSourceOpen: 2 }), ...view.items.slice(1).map((other) => ({ ...other, sameSourceOpen: 0 }))] });
    expect(out).toContain(AUTOMATION_WORDS.sameSource(2));
    expect(out.split("other open item").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(page({ ...view, items: view.items.map((other) => ({ ...other, sameSourceOpen: 0 })) })).not.toContain("other open item");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/automation-flag.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { CaseView, SIGNAL_RULES, type QueueRow } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { ActiveStaffSession } from "../../src/auth";
import { caseView, queue } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { caseById } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { aPost, ground, hex64, imagePost, intake, moderationDeps } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { one } from "./retention-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Each test records a dozen reports through the intake's own transaction and reads the queue page by page.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const SR = SIGNAL_RULES;
const SRC = path.resolve(__dirname, "../../src");

/**
 * Row 25 of the 3d design (sections 2 rows 47 and 48, 6.8, 7.13, 8.3, 8.4 and 10.3; Task 8): the flag "possible coordinated
 * reporting" is a hint and nothing more. case_flag answers three counts from rows 3c already keeps, with its own four
 * numbers, which are SIGNAL_RULES'; a signed-out notice is not in it; it goes dark once retention forgets a reporter; the
 * queue carries it and orders the same with it and without; the case answer carries it with each item's count of its
 * reporter's other open items; and the API calls it from those two reads and no third. Every report is recorded through
 * the intake's own statements, and every move of the clock is made as the migrator, in a transaction that is rolled back.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the flag possible coordinated reporting (3d Task 8, row 25)", () => {
  let migrateDb: Db;

  beforeAll(() => {
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await closeDb(migrateDb);
  });

  /** A post reported under R1 by `n` new signed-in accounts, one report each: the post, its case and the reporters, in order. */
  async function reported(tx: DbTx, n: number, postId?: string): Promise<{ postId: string; caseId: string; reporters: string[] }> {
    const post = postId ?? (await imagePost(tx, 0)).postId;
    const reporters: string[] = [];
    let caseId = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const reporter = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
      reporters.push(reporter.id);
      caseId = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R1"), aPost(post))).items[0]!.caseId!;
    }
    return { postId: post, caseId, reporters };
  }
  /** Each of these accounts follows the next, the last the first: every one of them follows another of them. */
  async function linked(tx: DbTx, ids: readonly string[]): Promise<void> {
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.follows (follower_id, followee_id) values (${ids[i]!}::uuid, ${ids[(i + 1) % ids.length]!}::uuid)`);
  }
  const flagOf = (tx: DbTx, caseId: string) => one<{ coordinated: boolean; items: number; reporters: number }>(tx, sql`select * from public.case_flag(${caseId}::uuid)`);
  /** The smallest number of reporters that is at least the linked share of these many. */
  const half = (n: number) => Math.ceil(n * SR.linkedShare);

  test("case_flag's four numbers are constants of its own, in the function's text, and they are SIGNAL_RULES'", async () => {
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ definition: string }>(sql`select pg_get_functiondef('public.case_flag(uuid)'::regprocedure) as definition`);
    const found = /SELECT ([0-9]+) AS min_items, ([0-9]+) AS min_reporters, ([0-9]+) AS window_minutes, ([0-9.]+)::numeric AS linked_share/.exec(row!.definition);
    expect(found).not.toBeNull();
    expect({ minItems: Number(found![1]), minReporters: Number(found![2]), windowMinutes: Number(found![3]), linkedShare: Number(found![4]) }).toEqual({ ...SR });
  });

  test("it answers true at minItems reports from minReporters accounts, at least half of them linked, and false one short of each; it answers counts and never a reporter", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const r = await reported(tx, SR.minReporters);
      expect(await flagOf(tx, r.caseId)).toEqual({ coordinated: false, items: SR.minItems, reporters: SR.minReporters });
      await linked(tx, r.reporters.slice(0, half(SR.minReporters)));
      expect(await flagOf(tx, r.caseId)).toEqual({ coordinated: true, items: SR.minItems, reporters: SR.minReporters });
      const [shape] = await tx.execute(sql`select * from public.case_flag(${r.caseId}::uuid)`);
      expect(Object.keys(shape!)).toEqual(["coordinated", "items", "reporters"]);
    });
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      // One account short: every one of them linked, and still no flag.
      const r = await reported(tx, SR.minReporters - 1);
      await linked(tx, r.reporters);
      expect(await flagOf(tx, r.caseId)).toEqual({ coordinated: false, items: SR.minItems - 1, reporters: SR.minReporters - 1 });
    });
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      // Enough accounts, one linked account short of the share.
      const r = await reported(tx, SR.minReporters);
      await linked(tx, r.reporters.slice(0, half(SR.minReporters) - 1));
      expect(await flagOf(tx, r.caseId)).toMatchObject({ coordinated: false, reporters: SR.minReporters });
    });
  });

  test("only reports within one window of windowMinutes count together", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const r = await reported(tx, SR.minReporters);
      await linked(tx, r.reporters);
      const last = (await one<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`select id from public.intake_items where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid order by seq desc limit 1`)).id;
      const move = (minutes: number) => tx.execute(sql`update public.intake_items set created_at = (select min(created_at) from public.intake_items where case_id = ${r.caseId}::uuid) + make_interval(mins => ${minutes}::int) where id = ${last}::uuid`);
      await move(SR.windowMinutes + 1);
      expect(await flagOf(tx, r.caseId)).toEqual({ coordinated: false, items: SR.minItems - 1, reporters: SR.minReporters - 1 });
      await move(SR.windowMinutes - 1);
      expect(await flagOf(tx, r.caseId)).toEqual({ coordinated: true, items: SR.minItems, reporters: SR.minReporters });
    });
  });

  test("a signed-out notice is not in it, and it goes dark once retention forgets a reporter", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const r = await reported(tx, SR.minReporters - 1);
      await linked(tx, r.reporters);
      // A notice sent without an account: no account, no graph.
      await intake(tx, ground.illegal(null), aPost(r.postId));
      expect(await flagOf(tx, r.caseId)).toEqual({ coordinated: false, items: SR.minItems - 1, reporters: SR.minReporters - 1 });
    });
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const r = await reported(tx, SR.minReporters);
      await linked(tx, r.reporters);
      expect((await flagOf(tx, r.caseId)).coordinated).toBe(true);
      // What forget_reporter (C 6.4) does to the items of an account whose deletion it records.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.intake_items set reporter_account_id = null where reporter_account_id = ${r.reporters[0]!}::uuid`);
      expect(await flagOf(tx, r.caseId)).toEqual({ coordinated: false, items: SR.minItems - 1, reporters: SR.minReporters - 1 });
    });
  });

  test("the queue carries the flag and orders the same with it and without; the case answer carries it, and each item the count of its reporter's other open items", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const deps = moderationDeps(tx);
      const r = await reported(tx, SR.minReporters);
      // Two of the reporters reported another post too: each of their items here names one other open item.
      const other = await reported(tx, 0);
      for (const reporter of r.reporters.slice(0, 2)) await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter, "R3"), aPost(other.postId));
      const allPages = async (): Promise<QueueRow[]> => {
        const found: QueueRow[] = [];
        let cursor: string | undefined;
        for (let page = 0; page < 200; page++) {
          const read = await queue(deps, cursor);
          found.push(...read.cases);
          if (read.nextCursor === null) return found;
          cursor = read.nextCursor;
        }
        throw new Error("the queue holds more than 200 pages");
      };
      const before = await allPages();
      expect(before.find((row) => row.id === r.caseId)!.flag).toBeNull();
      await linked(tx, r.reporters);
      const after = await allPages();
      expect(after.map((row) => row.id)).toEqual(before.map((row) => row.id));
      expect(after.find((row) => row.id === r.caseId)!.flag).toEqual({ items: SR.minItems, reporters: SR.minReporters });

      const now = new Date();
      const session: ActiveStaffSession = {
        sessionId: hex64(),
        handle: randomUUID(),
        userId: randomUUID(),
        keyId: randomUUID(),
        role: "moderator",
        createdAt: now,
        lastUsedAt: now,
        idleExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 15 * 60_000),
        absoluteExpiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 12 * 60 * 60_000),
        browser: "Firefox on Linux",
      };
      const view = await caseView(deps, session, (await caseById(tx, r.caseId))!);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse(view).success, JSON.stringify(CaseView.safeParse(view).error?.issues)).toBe(true);
      expect(view.flag).toEqual({ items: SR.minItems, reporters: SR.minReporters });
      expect(view.items.map((item) => item.sameSourceOpen)).toEqual([1, 1, 0, 0, 0]);
      // The other case's flag is null, and its items name the first case's as the reporters' other open ones.
      const otherView = await caseView(deps, session, (await caseById(tx, (await one<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`select case_id as id from public.intake_items where target_id = ${other.postId}::uuid limit 1`)).id))!);
      expect(otherView.flag).toBeNull();
      expect(otherView.items.map((item) => item.sameSourceOpen)).toEqual([1, 1]);
    });
  });

  test("the API names case_flag in two reads, the queue's and the case answer's, and in no third", () => {
    const files = (dir: string): string[] => readdirSync(dir).flatMap((name) => (statSync(path.join(dir, name)).isDirectory() ? files(path.join(dir, name)) : name.endsWith(".ts") ? [path.join(dir, name)] : []));
    const sources = files(SRC).map((file) => ({ file: path.relative(SRC, file).split(path.sep).join("/"), text: readFileSync(file, "utf8") }));
    const naming = sources.flatMap(({ file, text }) => [...text.matchAll(/public[.]case_flag[(]/g)].map(() => file));
    expect(naming).toEqual(["moderation/automated-repo.ts", "moderation/automated-repo.ts"]);
    // Each of the two reads is called once, from the queue and from the case answer, both in cases.ts.
    for (const read of ["queueFlags", "caseFlag"]) {
      const callers = sources.flatMap(({ file, text }) => [...text.matchAll(new RegExp(`(?<![A-Za-z])${read}[(]`, "g"))].map(() => file)).filter((file) => file !== "moderation/automated-repo.ts");
      expect(callers, read).toEqual(["moderation/cases.ts"]);
    }
    const cases = sources.find(({ file }) => file === "moderation/cases.ts")!.text;
    const queueBody = cases.slice(cases.indexOf("export async function queue("), cases.indexOf("// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the case answer"));
    expect(queueBody).toContain("queueFlags(");
    // The order is read before the flag: queueRows takes no flag, and nothing sorts the page after it.
    expect(queueBody.indexOf("queueRows(")).toBeLessThan(queueBody.indexOf("queueFlags("));
    expect(queueBody).not.toMatch(/[.]sort[(]/);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/automation-retention.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, EDGE_RULES, ExportFormat, RETENTION } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { createMatchRepo } from "../../src/media/match-repo";
import { insertMatchSignal, insertScoreSignal } from "../../src/moderation/automated-repo";
import { exportFor } from "../../src/moderation/export";
import { RETENTION_ACTION, retentionRound } from "../../src/moderation/retention";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { automationDeps, matchForTest, removeAutomation, signalForTest } from "./automation-fixtures";
import { ageCustodyForTest } from "./custody-fixtures";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { act, casesMedia, imagePost, moderationDeps, newImageRow, removeFixtures } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { ageCase, authAccount, one } from "./retention-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Real decisions are confirmed with a software authenticator, and a round of the retention job reads the whole database.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000, hookTimeout: 180_000 });

const KEEP = AUTOMATION_RULES.matchKeepDays;
const days = (n: number) => `${n} days`;

/**
 * Row 26 of the 3d design (sections 2 rows 33 and 37, 6.8, 6.10 and 7.14; Task 8): the records of the automated tools are
 * kept as the terms and the notices say, and no longer. The scenarios a person's or a program's decision makes are
 * committed through the API's own statements; every move of the clock is made as the migrator in a transaction that is
 * rolled back (the forced times can be moved by no other role, and no setting shortens a number of automation_rules()).
 * erase_automation_records is called as the retention job calls it; the job's three new steps run in a round of their own.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the retention of the automated tools' records (3d Task 8, row 26)", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let startedAt: string;
  // Read in beforeAll: the unit run imports this file without the integration environment.
  let config: Config;
  const authors: string[] = [];
  const media: string[] = [];
  const log = pino({ level: "silent" });

  beforeAll(async () => {
    config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    startedAt = (await one<{ now: string }>(apiDb, sql`select now()::text as now`)).now;
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await world.moderation.settle();
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, authors);
    await removeAutomation(migrateDb, startedAt, media);
    await world.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** One call of the function, as the job's step makes it. */
  const erase = async (tx: DbTx) => (await one<{ n: number }>(tx, sql`select public.erase_automation_records() as n`)).n;
  /** What a match record keeps of itself, by its image. */
  const recordOf = (tx: DbTx, mediaId: string) =>
    one<{ erased: boolean; hash: boolean; classification: boolean; source: string; list_version: string | null; hash_type: string; match_kind: string; acting: boolean }>(
      tx,
      sql`select erased_at is not null as erased, hash is not null as hash, classification is not null as classification, source, list_version, hash_type, match_kind, acting
            from public.media_matches where media_id = ${mediaId}::uuid`,
    );
  /** The rows of the five tables that are the proof of a destruction and of the word it rests on. */
  const proofCounts = (tx: DbTx) =>
    one<Record<string, number>>(
      tx,
      sql`select (select count(*)::int from public.releases) as releases, (select count(*)::int from public.release_posts) as release_posts,
                 (select count(*)::int from public.release_leaves) as release_leaves, (select count(*)::int from public.release_notices) as release_notices,
                 (select count(*)::int from public.quarantine_files) as quarantine_files`,
    );

  /** A post with one image by a new author, committed, whose image an acting match sealed by a program's decision. */
  async function matched() {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, 1);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    media.push(...p.mediaIds);
    const outcome = await signalForTest(automationDeps(apiDb, {}, { MEDIA_MATCH: "test" }), p.mediaIds[0]!, "known_match");
    if (outcome.caseId === null || outcome.decisionId === null) throw new Error("the match took no measure");
    return { ...p, caseId: outcome.caseId, decisionId: outcome.decisionId };
  }

  /** A release as the migrator records one, released that many days ago, of a post or of a refusal. */
  async function releaseFor(tx: DbTx, by: string, target: { postId: string } | { refusalId: string }, ago: number): Promise<string> {
    const { id } = await one<{ id: string }>(
      tx,
      "postId" in target
        ? sql`insert into public.releases (post_ids, basis, released_by, released_at, backups_clear_at, author_notice)
              values (array[${target.postId}::uuid], 'period', ${by}::uuid, now() - make_interval(days => ${ago}::int), now(), 'none') returning id`
        : sql`insert into public.releases (upload_refusal_id, post_ids, basis, released_by, released_at, backups_clear_at, author_notice)
              values (${target.refusalId}::uuid, '{}'::uuid[], 'period', ${by}::uuid, now() - make_interval(days => ${ago}::int), now(), 'none') returning id`,
    );
    if ("postId" in target) await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.release_posts (post_id, release_id) values (${target.postId}::uuid, ${id}::uuid)`);
    else await tx.execute(sql`update public.upload_refusals set release_id = ${id}::uuid where id = ${target.refusalId}::uuid`);
    return id;
  }

  test("a match record on a case is erased matchKeepDays after the case closed and not a day before; what stays names the source, the list's version, the hash type, the kind of match and whether it acted", async () => {
    expect(RETENTION.matchKeepDays).toBe(KEEP);
    const p = await matched();
    const answered = await world.decideAs(admin, p.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, matchAnswerReason: "source_withdrew" });
    if (typeof answered === "string") throw new Error(answered);
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await ageCase(tx, p.caseId, days(KEEP - 1));
      await erase(tx);
      expect(await recordOf(tx, p.mediaIds[0]!)).toMatchObject({ erased: false, hash: true, classification: true });
      await ageCase(tx, p.caseId, days(2));
      expect(await erase(tx)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(await recordOf(tx, p.mediaIds[0]!)).toEqual({ erased: true, hash: false, classification: false, source: "test", list_version: expect.any(String), hash_type: "sha256", match_kind: "exact", acting: true });
      // Once the record is erased, staff are no longer refused the image for a match (gate V reads unerased records).
      const [named] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.media_matches where media_id = ${p.mediaIds[0]!}::uuid and erased_at is null`);
      expect(named!.n).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  test("never while a seal for good in force lists the post and the post is not released; for a released post the days run from the release, and nothing of the release, its posts, the leaves, the notices or the quarantine is touched", async () => {
    const p = await matched();
    const sealed = await world.decideAs(admin, p.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    if (typeof sealed === "string") throw new Error(sealed);
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await ageCase(tx, p.caseId, days(KEEP * 3));
      await erase(tx);
      expect((await recordOf(tx, p.mediaIds[0]!)).erased).toBe(false);
      const release = await releaseFor(tx, admin.id, { postId: p.postId }, KEEP - 1);
      await erase(tx);
      expect((await recordOf(tx, p.mediaIds[0]!)).erased).toBe(false);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.releases set released_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP + 1}::int) where id = ${release}::uuid`);
      const before = await proofCounts(tx);
      expect(await erase(tx)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect((await recordOf(tx, p.mediaIds[0]!)).erased).toBe(true);
      expect(await proofCounts(tx)).toEqual(before);
    });
  });

  test("an upload's record is kept while its hold is unended or ended as report and not released; matchKeepDays after the release, or after an end as no_report, it is erased, and the refusal loses its account and its objection, also when korbat reported it", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const refused = async () => {
        const owner = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const image = await newImageRow(tx, owner.id, null);
        const matchId = await matchForTest(tx, image, "acting");
        const refusalId = await createMatchRepo(tx as unknown as Db).insertRefusal(tx, { mediaId: image, ownerId: owner.id, matchId });
        await tx.execute(sql`update public.upload_refusals set objection = 'It is a photo of my own garden.', objected_at = now() where id = ${refusalId}::uuid`);
        return { owner: owner.id, image, refusalId };
      };
      const refusalOf = (id: string) =>
        one<{ owner: string | null; objection: string | null; objected: boolean; ended: boolean; released: boolean }>(
          tx,
          sql`select owner_id as owner, objection, objected_at is not null as objected, ended_at is not null as ended, release_id is not null as released from public.upload_refusals where id = ${id}::uuid`,
        );

      // Reported and released: kept, unended, for three times the days; kept after the end as report; erased after the release.
      const a = await refused();
      await ageCustodyForTest(tx, { refusal: a.refusalId }, days(KEEP * 3));
      await erase(tx);
      expect((await recordOf(tx, a.image)).erased).toBe(false);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.upload_refusals set ended_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP * 2}::int), end_as = 'report', ended_by = ${a.owner}::uuid, notification_id = gen_random_uuid() where id = ${a.refusalId}::uuid`);
      await erase(tx);
      expect((await recordOf(tx, a.image)).erased).toBe(false);
      expect((await refusalOf(a.refusalId)).owner).toBe(a.owner);
      await releaseFor(tx, a.owner, { refusalId: a.refusalId }, KEEP - 1);
      await erase(tx);
      expect((await recordOf(tx, a.image)).erased).toBe(false);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.releases set released_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP + 1}::int) where upload_refusal_id = ${a.refusalId}::uuid`);
      await erase(tx);
      expect((await recordOf(tx, a.image)).erased).toBe(true);
      // What stays says that an upload was refused on a day and how its hold ended, and names nobody.
      expect(await refusalOf(a.refusalId)).toEqual({ owner: null, objection: null, objected: true, ended: true, released: true });

      // Ended as no_report: kept the day before, erased the day after.
      const b = await refused();
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.upload_refusals set ended_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP - 1}::int), end_as = 'no_report', end_reason = 'other', ended_by = ${b.owner}::uuid where id = ${b.refusalId}::uuid`);
      await erase(tx);
      expect((await recordOf(tx, b.image)).erased).toBe(false);
      expect((await refusalOf(b.refusalId)).owner).toBe(b.owner);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.upload_refusals set ended_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP + 1}::int) where id = ${b.refusalId}::uuid`);
      await erase(tx);
      expect((await recordOf(tx, b.image)).erased).toBe(true);
      expect(await refusalOf(b.refusalId)).toMatchObject({ owner: null, objection: null });
    });
  });

  test("a match that only flags, on an upload that was never posted, is erased matchKeepDays after the comparison", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {

  test("a request for a person is erased with its decision's texts, by 3c's test: once its subject's account has been deleted for 12 months; the program's signal, which its statement reads, goes then too and not before", async () => {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, 1);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    media.push(...p.mediaIds);
    const outcome = await signalForTest(automationDeps(apiDb), p.mediaIds[0]!);
    if (outcome.decisionId === null) throw new Error("the score took no measure");
    await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into public.automated_objections (decision_id, text) values (${outcome.decisionId}::uuid, 'It is a painting, please look again.')`);
    const objection = (tx: DbTx) =>
      one<{ text: string | null; erased: boolean }>(tx, sql`select text, erased_at is not null as erased from public.automated_objections where decision_id = ${outcome.decisionId!}::uuid`);
    const signals = async (tx: DbTx) => (await one<{ n: number }>(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.automated_signals where id = ${outcome.signalId}::uuid`)).n;
    // Its intake erased by 3c's retention, its subject alive: the signal stays, and the statement still reads it.
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.intakes set erased_at = now() where id = (select i.intake_id from public.intake_items i join public.automated_signals s on s.intake_item_id = i.id where s.id = ${outcome.signalId}::uuid)`);
      await authAccount(tx, p.authorId, "11 months");
      await erase(tx);
      expect(await objection(tx)).toEqual({ text: "It is a painting, please look again.", erased: false });
      expect(await signals(tx)).toBe(1);
      expect((await decisionStatement(tx as unknown as Db, outcome.decisionId!))!.statement.signal).toMatchObject({ kind: "r1_score" });
    });
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.intakes set erased_at = now() where id = (select i.intake_id from public.intake_items i join public.automated_signals s on s.intake_item_id = i.id where s.id = ${outcome.signalId}::uuid)`);
      await authAccount(tx, p.authorId, "13 months");
      expect(await erase(tx)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
      expect(await objection(tx)).toEqual({ text: null, erased: true });
      expect(await signals(tx)).toBe(0);
    });
  });

  test("a signal no statement reads is deleted: a score's handled as gone matchKeepDays after it was handled, a match's once its record is erased; an unhandled one never", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const p = await imagePost(tx, 3);
      const gone = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[0]!, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;
      const waiting = (await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[1]!, score: 1, thresholdVersion: 0 }))!;
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.automated_signals set handled = 'gone', handled_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP - 1}::int) where id = ${gone}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.automated_signals set created_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP * 3}::int) where id = ${waiting}::uuid`);
      const matchId = await matchForTest(tx, p.mediaIds[2]!, "other");
      const flagged = (await insertMatchSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[2]!, matchId }))!;
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.automated_signals set handled = 'gone', handled_at = now() where id = ${flagged}::uuid`);
      const left = async () => [...(await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from public.automated_signals where id in (${gone}::uuid, ${waiting}::uuid, ${flagged}::uuid) order by id`))].map((row) => row.id);
      await erase(tx);
      expect(await left()).toEqual([gone, waiting, flagged].sort());
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.automated_signals set handled_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP + 1}::int) where id = ${gone}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.media_matches set queried_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP + 1}::int) where id = ${matchId}::uuid`);
      await erase(tx);
      expect(await left()).toEqual([waiting]);
    });
  });

  test("the export (W.10): a program's decision is an entry with what its statement says of automated means and the objection with its time; a refused upload is listed as its notice reads it, with no file and no hash; a release only once its author may be told", async () => {
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, 1);
    authors.push(p.authorId);
    media.push(...p.mediaIds);
    const outcome = await signalForTest(automationDeps(apiDb), p.mediaIds[0]!);
    if (outcome.decisionId === null) throw new Error("the score took no measure");
    await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into public.automated_objections (decision_id, text) values (${outcome.decisionId}::uuid, 'It is a painting.')`);
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      // A held upload of the same account, objected to; and a release of its post whose notice is held.
      const image = await newImageRow(tx, p.authorId, null);
      const refusalId = await createMatchRepo(tx as unknown as Db).insertRefusal(tx, { mediaId: image, ownerId: p.authorId, matchId: await matchForTest(tx, image, "acting") });
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.upload_refusals set objection = 'It is my own photo.', objected_at = now() where id = ${refusalId}::uuid`);
      const release = await releaseFor(tx, admin.id, { postId: p.postId }, 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.releases set author_notice = 'held' where id = ${release}::uuid`);
      const exported = async () => ExportFormat.shape.moderation.parse(await exportFor(moderationDeps(tx), p.authorId));

      const held = await exported();
      const entry = held.decisions.find((decision) => decision.id === outcome.decisionId)!;
      expect(entry).toMatchObject({ kind: "interim", automatedDetection: true, automatedDecision: "fully", signal: { kind: "r1_score", source: null, matchKind: null, listedAs: null, viewed: null } });
      expect(entry.objection).toEqual({ text: "It is a painting.", createdAt: expect.stringMatching(/Z$/) });
      expect(held.uploads).toEqual([
        { id: refusalId, refusedAt: expect.any(String), source: "test", matchKind: "exact", listedAs: "csam", objection: { text: "It is my own photo.", objectedAt: expect.any(String) }, mayObject: false, endedAt: null, endAs: null, endReason: null, released: null, reportKept: false },
      ]);
      expect(JSON.stringify(held)).not.toMatch(/"hash"|classification|listVersion|"score"|"file"/);
      // While its notice is held, the release is in no export; once it may be told, it is, with its ground and its time.
      expect(held.releases).toEqual([]);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.releases set author_notice = 'pending' where id = ${release}::uuid`);
      expect((await exported()).releases).toEqual([{ id: release, basis: "period", releasedAt: expect.any(String), upload: false }]);
    });
  });

  describe("the retention job's three steps (7.14)", () => {
    const settings = (over: Partial<Config>) => ({ ...config, MODERATION_RETENTION: "on" as const, MEDIA_MATCH: "off", R1_CLASSIFIER: "off" as const, ...over });
    const auditSince = (tx: DbTx, after: number, step: string) =>
      tx.execute<{ metadata: Record<string, unknown>; actor_id: string; step_up: unknown }>(
        sql`select metadata, actor_id, step_up from public.audit_log where action = ${RETENTION_ACTION} and chain_seq > ${after} and metadata ->> 'step' = ${step} order by chain_seq`,
      );
    const head = async (tx: DbTx) => (await one<{ seq: number }>(tx, sql`select seq::int as seq from public.audit_head where id = 1`)).seq;

    test("edge_purges deletes the outbox rows done EDGE_RULES.keepDays ago, never one done later or still pending, with an audit row of its count", async () => {
      expect(RETENTION.edgePurgeDays).toBe(EDGE_RULES.keepDays);
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const ids: string[] = [];
        for (const done of [EDGE_RULES.keepDays + 1, EDGE_RULES.keepDays - 1, null]) {
          const { id } = await one<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`insert into public.edge_purges (media_id, cause, created_at, next_at) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'state', now(), now()) returning id::text as id`);
          if (done !== null) await tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set outcome = 'off', done_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${done}::int) where id = ${id}::bigint`);
          ids.push(id);
        }
        const after = await head(tx);
        const report = await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log, config: settings({ MEDIA_MATCH: "test", R1_CLASSIFIER: "test" }) });
        expect(report.edgePurges).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
        expect([...(await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id::text as id from public.edge_purges where id = any(${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::bigint[]) order by id`))].map((row) => row.id)).toEqual(ids.slice(1));
        const [row] = await auditSince(tx, after, "edge_purges");
        expect(row).toMatchObject({ metadata: { step: "edge_purges", count: report.edgePurges }, step_up: null });
      });
    });

    test("tools_off: while the comparison is off every stored hash goes, and while the R1 check is off every stored rating, but one an unhandled signal names; while a tool is on, nothing of it goes; and MODERATION_RETENTION=off holds every step but this one", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 3);
        const matches = createMatchRepo(tx as unknown as Db);
        for (const id of p.mediaIds) await matches.insertHashes(tx, id, { sha256: randomBytes(32), sha1: randomBytes(20), md5: randomBytes(16) });
        await tx.execute(sql`update public.post_media set nsfw_score = 0.9 where id = any(${`{${p.mediaIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
        // The third image's score waits for the sweep: a person is still to be shown it, so it stays.
        await insertScoreSignal(tx, { mediaId: p.mediaIds[2]!, score: 0.9, thresholdVersion: 0 });
        // A due outbox row, which MODERATION_RETENTION=off keeps.
        const { id: due } = await one<{ id: string }>(tx, sql`insert into public.edge_purges (media_id, cause, created_at, next_at) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'state', now(), now()) returning id::text as id`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update public.edge_purges set outcome = 'off', done_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${EDGE_RULES.keepDays + 1}::int) where id = ${due}::bigint`);
        const state = async () =>
          one<{ hashes: number; scores: number; purge: number }>(
            tx,
            sql`select (select count(*)::int from public.media_hashes) as hashes,
                       (select count(*)::int from public.post_media where nsfw_score is not null and id = any(${`{${p.mediaIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[])) as scores,
                       (select count(*)::int from public.edge_purges where id = ${due}::bigint) as purge`,
          );

        // On (the test adapters), and on with its measure: a tool keeps what it stored with the image.
        for (const acts of ["off", "on"] as const) {
          const kept = await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log, config: settings({ MODERATION_RETENTION: "off", MEDIA_MATCH: "test", R1_CLASSIFIER: "test", AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS: acts, AUTOMATION_R2_ACTS: acts }) });
          expect(kept.toolsOff).toBe(0);
          expect((await state()).hashes).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
          expect((await state()).scores).toBe(3);
        }

        // Off again after it ran, with the switch off: the step forgets both, writes its audit row, and nothing else runs.
        const after = await head(tx);
        const off = await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log, config: settings({ MODERATION_RETENTION: "off" }) });
        expect(off).toMatchObject({ drafts: 0, cases: 0, intakes: 0, statements: 0, automationRecords: 0, edgePurges: 0, batches: [], failed: 0 });
        expect(off.toolsOff).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5);
        expect(await state()).toEqual({ hashes: 0, scores: 1, purge: 1 });
        const rows = await auditSince(tx, after, "tools_off");
        expect(rows.map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([{ metadata: { step: "tools_off", caseId: null, intakeId: null, decisionId: null, count: off.toolsOff }, actor_id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", step_up: null }]);
        // A second round finds nothing to forget and writes nothing.
        const again = await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log, config: settings({ MODERATION_RETENTION: "off" }) });
        expect(again.toolsOff).toBe(0);
        expect(await auditSince(tx, after, "tools_off")).toHaveLength(1);
      });
    });

    test("automation_records is one call of erase_automation_records in a step of its own, with an audit row of its count", async () => {
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        const owner = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const image = await newImageRow(tx, owner.id, null);
        await matchForTest(tx, image, "other");
        await tx.execute(sql`update public.media_matches set queried_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${KEEP + 1}::int) where media_id = ${image}::uuid`);
        const after = await head(tx);
        const report = await retentionRound({ apiDb: tx as unknown as Db, media: casesMedia(tx), log, config: settings({}) });
        expect(report.automationRecords).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
        expect((await recordOf(tx, image)).erased).toBe(true);
        const [row] = await auditSince(tx, after, "automation_records");
        expect(row).toMatchObject({ metadata: { step: "automation_records", count: report.automationRecords }, step_up: null });
      });
    });
  });
});
```

### Create `packages/contracts/test/signals.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { AUTOMATION_RULES, CaseFlag, CaseItem, CaseView, EDGE_RULES, ExportFormat, ORDER_RULES, QueueRow, RETENTION, SIGNAL_RULES } from "../src/index";

/**
 * 3d Task 8 (design, sections 6.8, 6.10, 7.13, 10.1, 10.3 and W.10): the mirror of case_flag's four numbers, the flag and
 * the count of other open items as staff read them, RETENTION's three new members, each read from its own constant, and
 * the export's new members.
 */
const UUID = "1a2b3c4d-0000-4000-8000-0000000000e1";
const AT = "2026-10-19T10:00:00.000Z";

describe("the flag's numbers (10.1)", () => {
  test("SIGNAL_RULES is the design's: five items from five reporters within sixty minutes, half of them linked", () => {
    expect(SIGNAL_RULES).toEqual({ minItems: 5, minReporters: 5, windowMinutes: 60, linkedShare: 0.5 });
  });
});

describe("what staff read of the flag (10.3)", () => {
  test("the flag is two counts and nothing else: never a reporter", () => {
    expect(CaseFlag.parse({ items: 6, reporters: 5 })).toEqual({ items: 6, reporters: 5 });
    expect(CaseFlag.safeParse({ items: 6, reporters: 5, who: [UUID] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseFlag.safeParse({ items: -1, reporters: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseFlag.safeParse({ items: 1.5, reporters: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });
```

```ts
/** The headers each static file was served with, by path. */

/** The text of every element holding a person-written string or an action, kept in `seen`. */
async function texts(): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await userTexts(page);
  for (const text of found) seen.add(text);
  return found;
}

/** Waits for a locator to show, failing with what it looked for. */
async function shown(locator: Locator, timeout = 15_000): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await locator.first().waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`not shown within ${timeout} ms: ${locator.toString()}`);
  }
}

/** A virtual CTAP2 authenticator that verifies its user: a security key on USB, or a platform one whose passkeys sync. */
async function addAuthenticator(kind: "device-bound security key" | "synced platform passkey"): Promise<string> {
  const synced = kind === "synced platform passkey";
  const { authenticatorId } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator", {
    options: {
      protocol: "ctap2",
      transport: synced ? "internal" : "usb",
      hasResidentKey: true,
      hasUserVerification: true,
      isUserVerified: true,
      automaticPresenceSimulation: true,
      // The flags a password manager's passkey reports, and a security key never does.
      defaultBackupEligibility: synced,
      defaultBackupState: synced,
    },
  });
  return authenticatorId;
}

/** How many times an authenticator's keys have signed: the virtual authenticator counts every signature. */
async function signaturesOf(authenticatorId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { credentials } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.getCredentials", { authenticatorId });
  return credentials.reduce((sum, credential) => sum + credential.signCount, 0);
}

/** How many times every staff key of the walk has signed. */
async function signatures(): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const id of staffAuthenticators) sum += await signaturesOf(id);
  return sum;
}

/**
 * Waits until an expression is true in the page. The expression is plain text, sent as page.evaluate sends it: nothing
 * of the test runner's is put into the page, and nothing in the page evaluates it under the page's policy.
 */
async function until(expression: string, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries++) {
    if (await page.evaluate(expression)) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  }
  throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/**
 * Waits until the fixtures have seen something. A text is saved when its field loses focus, and the request arrives a
 * moment after the key press that moved the focus.
 */
async function arrived(check: () => boolean, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && !check(); tries++) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  if (!check()) throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/** The one image of the page: whether it is there, loaded as a real image of 2 by 2 pixels, from this address, drawn with this class. */
const imageIs = (src: string, className: string) =>
  `(() => { const all = document.querySelectorAll("img"); const i = all[0]; return all.length === 1 && i.getAttribute("src") === ${JSON.stringify(src)} && i.className === ${JSON.stringify(className)} && i.complete && i.naturalWidth === 2 && i.naturalHeight === 2; })()`;

/** The end of every step: no report, error or dialog on any channel, nothing in the page the console never writes, and no request the fixtures refused for the page's fault. */
async function clean(): Promise<void> {
  expect(watcher.take()).toEqual([]);
  expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
  expect(fixtures.state.problems).toEqual([]);
}

    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    await shown(dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Show hidden characters" }));
    // The refused read left the case on the page and says why on the page's error line; the name is still there.

    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}`).at(-1)!.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);

  test("a decision whose step-up options bind other params is refused before the key is asked; the draft stays, and confirmed again it is recorded without its texts being saved twice", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const sent = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path.endsWith("/decisions")).length;
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome this person may decide on the case; the page opens on a restriction.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.restricted, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    // A restriction needs a measure, its facts and its reason before anything can be confirmed.
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure));
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus: the facts when the reason was begun, the reason now.
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "reason", text: "It sells followers, which the rule names." });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    // Under both fields of a restriction: the rule on personal data, and that the author receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.personalData, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    const preview = composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.done.remove("2026-09-30 12:00 UTC"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`The facts: ${TYPED_FACTS}`);
    expect(await preview.last().textContent()).toMatch(/^You can appeal this decision once, free of charge, within six months of being told, until /);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);

    // The API asks the key to confirm another decision than the one the page built: the key is never asked.
    const [options, posted] = [fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed, sent()];
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("step_up_mismatch") }));
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options + 1);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(1);
    // The confirmation saved nothing more: both texts were on the server before it. What was chosen and written is still there.
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, with options that bind the decision itself: the saved texts are used as they are.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    const [facts, reason] = fixtures.state.texts.slice(-2);
    expect(facts).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });

  test("an admin's composer on a case with an unanswered report of child sexual abuse material: every outcome listed first, the choice not to seal only while deciding, and an answer without a measure that needs its facts, tells its author nothing and leaves the later report open", async () => {
    const [asked, before] = [fixtures.state.imageRequests.length, await signatures()];
    fixtures.state.role = "admin";
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_ADMIN}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome an admin may decide; beside them, that an answer now is given unseen.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.adminFinal).count()).toBe(0);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.unseen));
    // While deciding, the seal and the choice not to seal stand side by side.
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.interim).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }));
    // Deciding the case, an admin seals for good or answers without a seal: the choice not to seal is not offered.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.endsFreeze));
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.unseen));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);

    // An answer without a measure: no kind is asked, the category the key will confirm is shown, and the facts are needed.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "When" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "Measures" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Ground").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Category").inputValue()).toBe("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC");
    await composer.getByLabel("Category").selectOption("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    // Under both fields: never to say what the images are, and that the author never receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(`${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.toAuthor, { exact: false }).count()).toBe(0);
    // Nothing was done while deciding on this case, so the answer is told to nobody, and the page says so in the preview's place.
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement));
    expect(await composer.locator(".frame.preview").count()).toBe(0);
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("Nothing in the report or in the post supports it.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason and the facts saved when their fields lost focus");
    const written = (kind: string) => fixtures.state.texts.slice(saved).find((text) => text.kind === kind)!;
    expect(written("facts")).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_ADMIN, text: TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    await clean();

    await confirm.click();
    // The answer reaches the newest report of child sexual abuse material: the rule report that arrived after it stays open.
    await shown(page.getByText(`${COMPOSER.recorded} ${COMPOSER.leftForLater(1)}`));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_ADMIN,
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 3, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [], factsDigest: written("facts").digest, reasonDigest: written("reason").digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The case as the answer gave it: the answer with its facts, for staff, and a composer for the report left open.
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 4", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    const after = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    expect(await after.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(1);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.not_evident, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked);
    expect(await page.locator("img").count()).toBe(0);
    // The steps that follow are a moderator's again: each opens its page anew, and reads who is signed in.
    fixtures.state.role = "moderator";
    await clean();
  });

  test("a case that another staff member decided meanwhile: a save that failed is worded under its field and made again by the confirmation, the refusal is worded in place, the case is read again with the draft kept, and confirmed again the decision is recorded without a text saved twice", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();

    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.not_evident, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    // One image withheld while deciding: a measure that still stands once another staff member has hidden the post.

    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);

    fixtures.state.refuseNextSave = "rate_limited";

    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);

    // Another staff member withholds the post while this page still shows the case as it read it.
    fixtures.decideBehindThePage(CASE_CHANGED);

    await confirm.click();
    // The confirmation saved the reason, the key signed the decision the page showed, and the API refused it: in place.
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("case_changed") }));
    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429, 201]);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(requests("POST", "/decisions")).toEqual([409]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.filter((made) => made.caseId === CASE_CHANGED)).toEqual([]);
    // The page read the case again, once: the other decision is on it, and the composer follows the case as it now stands.

    await shown(page.getByText("; version 2", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(OTHER_STAFF);
    // The case hides the post now: a second withhold of the post is not offered, and the image measure changes nothing now.
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.alreadyHidden));
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold.label, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.noEffect));
    expect(await composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text").first().textContent()).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.done.withhold_media("2026-09-30 12:00 UTC")} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.already("image")}`);
    // The refusal's words stay, the reason's own refusal is gone now that it is saved, and the draft is as its person left it.
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("case_changed") }));
    expect(await composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: NOTE_WORDS.rate_limited }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(REASON);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold_media.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(requests("GET", "")).toHaveLength(read + 1);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, on the version the page now shows: the texts are used as they were saved.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 2);
    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429, 201]);
    expect(requests("POST", "/decisions")).toEqual([409, 201]);
    const mine = fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_CHANGED);
    expect(mine.map((text) => [text.kind, text.text])).toEqual([
      ["facts", TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS],
      ["reason", REASON],
    ]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_CHANGED,
      params: { kind: "interim", stateVersion: 2, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }], factsDigest: mine[0]!.digest, reasonDigest: mine[1]!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 3", { exact: false }));
    expect(await page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" }).getByRole("alert").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a draft's texts come back after a reload: each was saved when its field lost focus, a refused save is worded under its field with the text kept, a saved text is restored with its digest, one answered with other words under its digest is dropped, and the decision names the text saved before the reload", async () => {
    const [before, options] = [await signatures(), fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed];
    const QUOTING = 'The reporter wrote "this account spams one link everywhere".';
    const REASON = "The post repeats one link, which the rule names.";
    const saves = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}/texts`).map((r) => r.status);
    const mine = () => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_DRAFTS);
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "facts", text: TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS });
    // A text that quotes what someone wrote about the case is refused where it was written, and nothing of it is lost.
    fixtures.state.refuseNextSave = "text_quotes_user";
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(QUOTING);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("text_quotes_user") }));
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(QUOTING);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422]);
    expect(mine()).toHaveLength(1);
    // Written again in the person's own words, the refusal's words go, and the text is saved when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await composer.getByRole("alert").waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: "reason", text: REASON });
    // No key was asked for any of it.
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options);
    await clean();

    // A reload before any confirmation: the case's answer brings the saved texts back. This one answers the reason with
    // other words under the digest of what was saved: the page holds each text to its digest, and drops that one.
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = { caseId: CASE_DRAFTS, kind: "reason" };
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const again = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await shown(again);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe("");
    expect(await page.content()).not.toContain(FORGED_DRAFT);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201]);
    await clean();

    // A measure and a reason later the key confirms the decision. The click that confirms takes the focus from the
    // reason's field: that save ends first, the confirmation saves nothing, and the facts are the ones saved before the reload.
    await again.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold.label, { exact: true }).check();
    await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await again.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201, 201]);
    expect(mine().map((text) => text.kind)).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "reason"]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_DRAFTS,
      params: { kind: "interim", stateVersion: 1, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: mine()[0]!.digest, reasonDigest: mine()[2]!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = null;
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });

  test("home lists, for every staff member, the decisions that lifted the protection of reported images, the choices not to seal and the seals taken while deciding, each with its staff handle as text and its case", async () => {
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Home" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Home" }));

    expect(await lists.count()).toBe(4);
    expect(await lists.nth(1).locator("li").innerText()).toContain(PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS.dismissed);
    expect(await lists.nth(1).locator("a").getAttribute("href")).toBe(`/cases/${CASE_FROZEN}`);

  test("a review with the key: the appellant's statement as text on the case, Keep, Reverse in part and Reverse, the reason saved as a review reason, the preview the review's statement, the key confirming exactly that review, and the appeal answered", async () => {
    await page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").nth(1).getByRole("link", { name: "Open the case" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    await shown(page.getByText("not answered yet", { exact: false }));
    // What the appellant wrote is text in a frame of its own.
    expect(await texts()).toContain(HOSTILE.img);
    const before = await signatures();
    const decisionsBefore = fixtures.state.decisions.length;
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel }).click();
    const review = page.getByRole("region", { name: COMPOSER.reviewLabel });
    await shown(review);
    const confirm = review.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // "Keep" is chosen and lifts nothing; nothing is confirmed without a reason.
    expect(await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.kept, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await review.getByLabel("Reason of the review").fill(TYPED_REVIEW_REASON);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // A decision with one measure cannot be reversed in part: whatever is ticked, the answer does not stand.
    await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.partly_reversed, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await review.getByLabel(MEASURES.restore.label).check();
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    // "Reverse" lifts everything that is still in force, and says so by its ticked box.
    await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.reversed, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await review.getByLabel(MEASURES.restore.label).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // The preview is the statement its author will receive: the review's lead, and what was typed as its reason.
    const preview = review.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.reviewed("2026-10-01 09:00 UTC", "reversed"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`Why korbat changed it: ${TYPED_REVIEW_REASON}`);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.reviewed));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    const reason = fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)!;
    expect(reason).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_APPEALED, kind: "review_reason", text: TYPED_REVIEW_REASON });
    // What the key confirmed is the review the page showed: of that decision, answering that appeal, with that reversal
    // and the digest of the saved reason. No decision on the case was sent in its place.
    expect(fixtures.state.reviews).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(fixtures.state.reviews[0]).toMatchObject({
      decisionId: DECISION_APPEALED,
      params: { stateVersion: 3, appealId: APPEAL_ONE, outcome: "reversed", rulesVersion: 2, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }], reasonDigest: reason.digest },
    });
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(decisionsBefore);
    // The case as the answer gave it: the next version, the removal lifted, the appeal answered, and nothing left to review.
    await shown(page.getByText("version 4", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByText("answered: reversed", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByText(`${MEASURES.remove.label}: lifted by the decision of`, { exact: false }));
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_REVIEW_REASON);
    // The appeals screen no longer lists it.
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Appeals" }).click();
    await shown(page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").first());
    expect(await page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").count()).toBe(1);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a post decision signs the strike the case answer says is due: the author's standing in bands above the evidence, the strike line under Restrict, the preview's strike, and the key confirming the removal with its strike", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();

    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });

    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.strike.label, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(STRIKE_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_STRIKE).length === 2, "both texts saved when their fields lost focus");
    // The preview tells the strike as its author will read it: the third active strike, the band's two and this one.
    const preview = composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    const told = (await preview.allTextContents()).join(" ");
    expect(told).toContain("This decision gives your account a strike.");

    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automationStrike);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    // What the key confirmed: the removal and the strike, which the page added because the answer said it was due.
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_STRIKE,
      params: { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }], unfounded: [], replaced: false },
    });
    // The case as the answer gave it: the strike in force with the day it stops counting, and the band one higher.
    await shown(page.getByText(`${MEASURES.strike.label}: in force; counts until`, { exact: false }));
    await shown(standing.getByText(STANDING_WORDS.bands.activeStrikes["3_or_more"], { exact: true }));
    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

  test("3f: at 360 by 740 px, home shows the block Authorities above the lanes: [home.contact] with its link to Contact point, and [home.channel]", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });

    const since = new Date(Date.now() - 6 * 60_000).toISOString();
    fixtures.state.authorities = {
      contact: { open: 2, oldestAt: oldest, dueAt: new Date(Date.parse(oldest) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000).toISOString() },
      alerts: { channel: "down", since },
    };
    await page.goto(`${origin}/`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Authorities" }));
    const words = ORDER_WORDS.home.contact(bothTimes(oldest), 2);
    const lines = page.locator(".authorities p");
    // Its text as written: at this width the link is laid out as a block of its own, which innerText would break apart.
    expect(await lines.nth(0).textContent()).toBe(`${words.before}${words.link}${words.after}`);
    // Task 2: the nearest deadline, the message's, with its minutes left, a link to Orders.

    expect(await lines.nth(2).textContent()).toBe(ORDER_WORDS.home.channel(bothTimes(since)));
    expect(await page.locator(".authorities a").nth(0).getAttribute("href")).toBe("/contact");
    expect(await page.locator(".authorities a").nth(1).getAttribute("href")).toBe("/orders");
    // The block stands above the lanes.
    const authorities = await page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Authorities" }).boundingBox();
    const cases = await page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Cases" }).boundingBox();

    // Every read the home screen started has finished: the whole screen is measured.

    await shown(page.locator("ul.keys"));
    await shown(page.getByText("This session", { exact: true }));
    await texts();
    await cleanOnPhone();
  });

  test("3f Task 6: at 360 by 740 px, Download since my last copy asks the key, records the copy only once the whole file has arrived, and a download cut short records nothing", async () => {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 360, height: 740 });
    const head = Math.max(...fixtures.state.audit.map((row) => row.seq));
    try {
      await page.goto(`${origin}/audit`);
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.downloadFirst(AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX), { exact: true }));
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.key, { exact: true }));
      const before = await signatures();
      const button = page.getByRole("button", { name: RECOVERY_WORDS.downloadButton });
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.done(1, head, head), { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
      expect(fixtures.state.exports.at(-1)).toEqual({ after: 0, through: head });
      expect(fixtures.state.marks).toEqual([{ through: head, hash: fixtures.state.audit.find((row) => row.seq === head)!.hash }]);
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.download(head, AUDIT_EXPORT_MAX), { exact: true }));
      // Nothing newer: no key is asked.
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.none(head), { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
      // Ten more rows, and a body that breaks off after three of them: the key confirmed it, nothing is marked.
      const newer = Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => ({ ...fixtures.state.audit[0]!, seq: head + 10 - i, hash: (head + 10 - i).toString(16).padStart(64, "a"), actionHash: null, keyId: null, action: "staff_sign_in" }));
      fixtures.state.audit.unshift(...newer);
      fixtures.state.exportCut = 3;
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.broken, { exact: true }));
      expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 2);
      expect(fixtures.state.exports.at(-1)).toEqual({ after: head, through: head + 10 });
      expect(fixtures.state.marks).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(fixtures.state.copyPlace).toBe(head);
      // Pressed again, the download starts at the same place and is recorded.
      await button.click();
      await shown(page.getByText(RECOVERY_WORDS.done(head + 1, head + 10, 10), { exact: true }));
      expect(fixtures.state.marks.at(-1)!.through).toBe(head + 10);
      await texts();
      await cleanOnPhone();
    } finally {
      await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 900 });
    }
  });
```
