    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).profile.showInExplore).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, showInExplore: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, showInExplore: "off" } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the profile lists the account's own handles that korbat retired, each with when, beside the handle history (3e design, W.8)", () => {
    // Added to korbat-export-1 last in the profile, as the Explore switch was: always there, empty when nothing is retired.
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).profile.retiredHandles).toEqual([{ handle: "ada_l", retiredAt: at }]);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: [] } }).profile.retiredHandles).toEqual([]);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: [{ handle: "ada_l", retiredAt: null }] } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: [{ handle: "ada_l" }] } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the account's passkeys carry a name, their times, whether they are synced and where they were added, and nothing that identifies the key", () => {
    const [laptop] = full.account.passkeys;
    const withPasskeys = (passkeys: unknown) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, passkeys } }).success;
    // The list is part of the format since 1c: always present, empty for an account without passkeys.
    expect(withPasskeys(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([])).toBe(true);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, lastUsedAt: null, createdOn: null }])).toBe(true);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, lastUsedAt: undefined }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, createdOn: undefined }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, name: undefined }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, createdAt: "last week" }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, synced: "yes" }])).toBe(false);
    // A reader gets the five fields and no more: nothing of the key, its id or its authenticator is part of the format.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, passkeys: [{ ...laptop, id: id(7), credentialId: "Y3JlZA", publicKey: "cose", aaguid: id(8) }] } });
    expect(parsed.account.passkeys).toEqual([laptop]);
  });

  test("a deleted post keeps its place with an empty body and a deletion time; an attached image has its dimensions", () => {
    const [post] = full.posts;
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, state: "hidden" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, replyToId: undefined }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, media: [{ id: id(3), file: "media/x.webp", altText: "a cat" }] }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, media: undefined }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("engagement entries name a post and a time, graph entries a handle and a time", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, likes: [{ postId: "nope", at }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, bookmarks: [{ postId: id(5) }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, following: [{ handle: "grace" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, mutes: [{ handle: "loud", since: "last week" }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("sessions, devices, events and missing media keep their shapes", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, sessions: [{ id: id(9), createdAt: at, lastUsedAt: at }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, devices: [{ ...full.devices[0], label: null }] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, devices: [{ ...full.devices[0], platform: "desktop" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, events: [{ type: "signup" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, missingMedia: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the export's moderation member", () => {
  const [decision, correction] = full.moderation.decisions;
  const [report] = full.moderation.reports;
  const [released, waiting] = report!.items;
  const withModeration = (moderation: unknown) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, moderation }).success;
  const withDecision = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [{ ...decision, ...change }], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING });
  const withReport = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [{ ...report, ...change }], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING });
  const withItem = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withReport({ items: [{ ...released, ...change }] });

  test("is part of korbat-export-1 since 3c, the last member of the document: always present, with its two lists, either of which may be empty", () => {
    // Added without a new format name, as the passkeys and the Explore switch were: a reader that skips it loses nothing.
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).format).toBe("korbat-export-1");
    expect(Object.keys(ExportFormat.shape).at(-1)).toBe("moderation");
    expect(withModeration(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ reports: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [] })).toBe(false);
    // 3e: the strikes, the standing measures, the replies and the reporting counts are always there too.
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [], standing: [], replies: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING })).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [decision], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING })).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [report], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a decision carries its day, the post it concerns, its kind, outcome, ground, rule and rules version, its measures with whether each changed anything, its reversals, the texts still held and where the appeal stands", () => {
    expect(withDecision({})).toBe(true);
    // The day, never the time: the list of decisions shows a day too.
    expect(withDecision({ decidedOn: at })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ decidedOn: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A decision about the account names no post; the member is null then, never missing.
    expect(withDecision({ postId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ postId: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ postId: "the-post" })).toBe(false);
    // 3f (W.7): an order's decision is an entry like any other once its author was told.
    for (const kind of ["interim", "final", "order", "review", "correction"]) expect(withDecision({ kind }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ kind: "appeal" })).toBe(false);
    for (const outcome of ["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withDecision({ outcome }), outcome).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ outcome: "suspended" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ ground: "other" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ ruleId: "R7" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ rulesVersion: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ rulesVersion: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // The fourteen measures (3c's seven, 3e's six and 3f's order measure) and nothing else; a reversal is no measure, and a measure no reversal.
    for (const kind of MEASURE_KINDS) expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind, mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    for (const noEffect of ["already", "deleted", null]) expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect }] }), String(noEffect)).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: "no" }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    for (const kind of ["restore", "unseal_media", "restore_media", "restore_display_name", "restore_bio"]) expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind, mediaId: null }] }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A text that is not held, or that the decision never had, is null, never missing.
    expect(withDecision({ facts: null, reason: null, legalReference: null })).toBe(true);
    for (const text of ["facts", "reason", "legalReference"]) expect(withDecision({ [text]: undefined }), text).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).moderation.decisions[1]).toEqual(correction);
  });

  test("an appeal is pending without a result or answered with one, and null when none was filed", () => {
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "pending", result: null } })).toBe(true);
    for (const result of ["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "answered", result } }), result).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "pending", result: "kept" } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "answered", result: null } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "withdrawn", result: null } })).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a decision is read with its own members and no more: nothing of who reported, who decided or how many reports there were is part of the format", () => {
    const extra = { ...decision, decidedBy: id(20), staffHandle: "mod_one", reporterId: id(21), reporterHandle: "grace", reports: 3, source: "report", caseId: id(22) };
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [extra], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.decisions).toEqual([decision]);
  });

  test("a report carries its reference, when korbat received it, its ground with the rule it cited, its category and its sender's own explanation while that is held", () => {
    expect(withReport({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ ref: "N-abc" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ receivedAt: "last week" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R6", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" })).toBe(true);
    // A report on the path for child sexual abuse material records no sender, so it is in nobody's export.
    expect(withReport({ ground: "csam" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: "R9" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // Read with its own members and no more.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING, reports: [{ ...report, reporterId: id(1), contactId: id(23), lookupHash: "f".repeat(64), token: "secret" }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports).toEqual([report]);
  });

  test("an item carries its place in the report, its link and whether it is a re-examination; its outcome, the outcome's words and whether a re-examination is open come together, with the release, or not at all", () => {
    expect(withItem({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ items: [waiting] })).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ position: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ position: 21 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ link: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexamines: undefined })).toBe(false);
    for (const outcome of ["restricted_rule", "restricted_legal", "no_violation", "not_evident", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withItem({ outcome }), outcome).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ outcome: "restricted" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: false })).toBe(true);
    // Released, all three are told; before the release, none is.
    expect(withItem({ outcome: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ outcomeText: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, reexaminationOpen: false }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, outcomeText: "no action" }] })).toBe(false);
    // An item is read with its own members and no more: the list's id of an item is not part of the export.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING, reports: [{ ...report, items: [{ ...released, id: id(24), caseId: id(25), answeredBy: id(26) }] }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports[0]!.items).toEqual([released]);
  });
});

describe("the moderation member's standing, replies and reporting (3e design, W.8)", () => {
  const [suspension, warning] = full.moderation.standing;
  const [answered] = full.moderation.replies;
  const [counting, withdrawn] = full.moderation.reporting.marks;
  const withModeration = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, moderation: { ...full.moderation, ...change } }).success;
  const withStanding = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ standing: [{ ...suspension, ...change }] });
  const withReply = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ replies: [{ ...answered, ...change }] });
  const withReporting = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ reporting: { ...full.moderation.reporting, ...change } });
  const withMark = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withReporting({ marks: [{ ...counting, ...change }] });

  test("come after the strikes, in this order, and every one of them is always there", () => {
    // 3d (W.10): the refused uploads and the releases come last.
    expect(Object.keys(ExportFormat.shape.moderation.shape)).toEqual(["decisions", "reports", "strikes", "standing", "replies", "reporting", "uploads", "releases"]);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).moderation).toEqual(full.moderation);
    for (const member of ["standing", "replies", "reporting"]) expect(withModeration({ [member]: undefined }), member).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a standing entry is a suspension, a termination, a warning or a restriction of reporting, with its basis, days, times, lift and broken basis", () => {
    expect(withStanding({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ standing: [warning] })).toBe(true);
    for (const kind of ["suspend", "terminate", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"]) expect(withStanding({ kind }), kind).toBe(true);
    // A strike is in strikes, a retirement in the profile's retired handles; neither is a standing entry.
    for (const kind of ["strike", "retire_handle", "remove"]) expect(withStanding({ kind }), kind).toBe(false);
    for (const basis of ["strikes", "threat", "terrorist", "flood", "protective", "threat_repeat", "ladder_end", "reports"]) expect(withStanding({ basis }), basis).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ basis: "other" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withStanding({ days: null, kind: "terminate" })).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ days: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withStanding({ days: 31 })).toBe(false);
    // A period that never started, or a termination without end, has no start or no end.
    expect(withStanding({ startsAt: null, endsAt: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ basisEndedAt: at, basisEndedBy: id(33) })).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ replaced: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withStanding({ liftedBy: "a staff member" })).toBe(false);
    // An entry is read with its own members and no more: who decided is not part of it.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { ...full.moderation, standing: [{ ...suspension, decidedBy: id(40), handle: "staff" }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.standing).toEqual([suspension]);
  });

  test("a reply carries when it was filed, whether it was on time, its text while korbat holds it, when that was erased and its answer", () => {
    expect(withReply({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ text: null, erasedAt: at })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ text: null, erasedAt: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ answeredAt: null, answeredBy: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ text: "x".repeat(2001) })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReply({ onTime: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReply({ filedAt: "yesterday" })).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the reporting counts carry the frame, the reports of each day, each mark by its own report's reference and position, and the marked reports a threshold reads", () => {
    expect(withReporting({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ reporting: { frameDays: 90, days: [], marks: [], markedReports: 0 } })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReporting({ marks: [withdrawn] })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReporting({ frameDays: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReporting({ markedReports: -1 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReporting({ days: [{ day: at, reports: 1 }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReporting({ days: [{ day: "2026-09-24", reports: 0 }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withMark({ ref: "not a reference" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withMark({ position: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withMark({ sentOn: at })).toBe(false);
    expect(withMark({ counts: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A mark names the account's own report and nothing else: never the item, the decision or who was reported.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { ...full.moderation, reporting: { ...full.moderation.reporting, marks: [{ ...counting, itemId: id(41), decisionId: id(42), target: "u/bob" }] } } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reporting.marks).toEqual([counting]);
  });
});

describe("laneFor", () => {
  const TC: TdbCategory = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC";

  test("a rule report takes its rule's lane: R2 and R5 are urgent, R3 and R4 next, R1 and R6 last", () => {
    const lanes = RULE_IDS.map((ruleId) => laneFor({ ruleId, allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category: TC }));
    expect(lanes).toEqual([2, 0, 1, 1, 0, 2]);
  });

  test("the CSAM path is lane 0 whatever else the intake says", () => {
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: true, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: false, csam: true, category: TC })).toBe(0);
  });

  test("a notice of illegality takes its category's lane, for every category", () => {
    const urgent = ["STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM"];
    const next = [
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
      "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE",
    ];
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      const expected = urgent.includes(category) ? 0 : next.includes(category) ? 1 : 2;
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(expected);
    }
  });

  test("a notice of illegality that also cites a rule takes the more severe of the two lanes", () => {
    // Fraud (lane 2) under R5 (lane 0), and violence (lane 0) under R1 (lane 2): both are urgent.
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R5", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R1", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE" })).toBe(0);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R3", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" })).toBe(1);
    expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R6", allegesIllegal: true, csam: false, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE" })).toBe(2);
  });

  test("where nothing is alleged to be illegal, the category is korbat's own classification and moves no lane", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R1", allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(2);
      expect(laneFor({ ruleId: "R3", allegesIllegal: false, csam: false, category }), category).toBe(1);
    }
  });
});

  });

    expect(SEAL_LIST_MAX).toBe(500);
    expect(SUSPECT_EARLIER_MONTHS).toBe(12);
  });

  test("six months to appeal or to ask for a re-examination, five of each a day", () => {
    expect(APPEAL_MONTHS).toBe(6);
    expect(DAILY_LIMITS).toEqual({ appeals: 5, reexaminations: 5 });
  });

  test("the retention periods of the design's table", () => {
    expect(RETENTION).toEqual({
      r4FinalMonths: 6,
      intakeDays: 30,
      resetValueDays: 30,
      evidenceHours: 24,
      statementMonths: 12,
      accessLogMonths: 12,
      contactMonths: 6,
      contactMaxMonths: 13,
      confirmationDays: 30,
      backupDays: 30,
      draftHours: 24,
      mailGiveUpDays: 5,
      // 3e (design, sections 6.7 and 10.1, W.7): a reply's text, the reporting counts and the record of standing measures.
      replyText: "until korbat has answered it and its decision can no longer be appealed",
      reportCountDays: 90,
      standingRecord: { strikeDays: 90, ladderMemoryDays: 365, warningDays: 90 },
      // 3f (design, sections 6.8 and 10.1, W.6): a handled message, what a removal order disabled, an order's and an
      // authority's records, and a restore gap closed as not needed or imported.
      contactMessageDays: 30,
      orderPreserveMonths: 6,
      orderRecordYears: 3,
      restoreGapMonths: 12,
      // 3d (design, sections 6.10 and W.9): a match record's hash, an uploader's address after a refusal, an edge outbox row.
      matchKeepDays: 180,
      reportHoldDays: 7,
      edgePurgeDays: 30,
    });
    // Content restricted under R4 goes when its restriction is final: the appeal's window.
    expect(RETENTION.r4FinalMonths).toBe(APPEAL_MONTHS);
    // 3e's periods are the standing rules' own numbers, read from STANDING_RULES and never typed twice.
    expect(RETENTION.reportCountDays).toBe(STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays);
    expect(RETENTION.standingRecord).toEqual({ strikeDays: STANDING_RULES.strikeDays, ladderMemoryDays: STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays, warningDays: STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays });
    // 3f's are order_rules()' own numbers, read from ORDER_RULES, which mirrors the function, and never typed twice.
    expect([RETENTION.contactMessageDays, RETENTION.orderPreserveMonths, RETENTION.orderRecordYears, RETENTION.restoreGapMonths]).toEqual([
      ORDER_RULES.messageKeepDays,
      ORDER_RULES.preserveMonths,
      ORDER_RULES.recordKeepYears,
      ORDER_RULES.gapKeepMonths,
    ]);
  });
});

describe("the measures", () => {
  const kinds = Object.keys(MEASURES) as ActionKind[];
  const measures = kinds.filter((kind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts === null);
  const reversals = kinds.filter((kind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts !== null);

  test("every action kind has an entry: 3c's seven measures and five reversals, then 3e's six measures and four reversals, then 3f's measure and its reversal", () => {
    expect(kinds).toEqual([
      "withhold",
      "remove",
      "seal_media",
      "withhold_media",
      "remove_media",
      "reset_display_name",
      "reset_bio",
      "restore",
      "unseal_media",
      "restore_media",
      "restore_display_name",
      "restore_bio",
      "strike",
      "suspend",
      "terminate",
      "retire_handle",
      "warn_reporting",
      "restrict_reporting",
      "overrule",
      "lift_suspension",
      "unretire_handle",
      "lift_reporting",
      "disable_by_order",
      "reinstate_by_order",
    ]);
    expect(ACTION_KINDS).toEqual(kinds);
    expect(ACTION_KINDS).toHaveLength(24);
    expect(measures).toEqual([...kinds.slice(0, 7), ...kinds.slice(12, 18), "disable_by_order"]);
    expect(reversals).toEqual([...kinds.slice(7, 12), ...kinds.slice(18, 22), "reinstate_by_order"]);
    expect(MEASURE_KINDS).toEqual(measures);
    expect(MEASURE_KINDS).toHaveLength(14);
    expect(REVERSAL_KINDS).toEqual(reversals);
    expect(REVERSAL_KINDS).toHaveLength(10);
  });

  test("a post or one image is withheld only while deciding and removed only when the case is decided; a seal and a reset are either; 3e's measures only when it is decided", () => {
    const when = (kind: ActionKind) => [MEASURES[kind].interim, MEASURES[kind].final];
    expect(when("withhold")).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(when("withhold_media")).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(when("remove")).toEqual([false, true]);
    expect(when("remove_media")).toEqual([false, true]);
    for (const kind of ["seal_media", "reset_display_name", "reset_bio"] as const) expect(when(kind), kind).toEqual([true, true]);
    for (const kind of ["strike", "suspend", "terminate", "retire_handle", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"] as const) expect(when(kind), kind).toEqual([false, true]);
    // A reversal is neither: which decision may hold one is the reversed measure's matter.
    for (const kind of reversals) expect(when(kind), kind).toEqual([false, false]);
  });

  test("each measure has its target, and each reversal lifts the measures of its own target", () => {
    expect(Object.fromEntries(kinds.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].target]))).toEqual({
      withhold: "post",
      remove: "post",
      seal_media: "images",
      withhold_media: "image",
      remove_media: "image",
      reset_display_name: "display_name",
      reset_bio: "bio",
      restore: "post",
      unseal_media: "images",
      restore_media: "image",
      restore_display_name: "display_name",
      restore_bio: "bio",
      strike: "account",
      suspend: "account",
      terminate: "account",
      retire_handle: "handle",
      warn_reporting: "reporting",
      restrict_reporting: "reporting",
      overrule: "account",
      lift_suspension: "account",
      unretire_handle: "handle",
      lift_reporting: "reporting",
      disable_by_order: "post",
      reinstate_by_order: "post",
    });
    expect(Object.fromEntries(reversals.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].lifts]))).toEqual({
      restore: ["withhold", "remove"],
      unseal_media: ["seal_media"],
      restore_media: ["withhold_media", "remove_media"],
      restore_display_name: ["reset_display_name"],
      restore_bio: ["reset_bio"],
      overrule: ["strike"],
      lift_suspension: ["suspend", "terminate"],
      unretire_handle: ["retire_handle"],
      lift_reporting: ["warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"],
      reinstate_by_order: ["disable_by_order"],
    });
    // Every measure can be lifted, by exactly one kind of reversal, of the measure's own target.
    for (const measure of measures) expect(reversals.filter((kind) => (MEASURES[kind].lifts as readonly ActionKind[]).includes(measure)), measure).toHaveLength(1);
    for (const kind of reversals) for (const lifted of MEASURES[kind].lifts as readonly ActionKind[]) expect(MEASURES[lifted].target, kind).toBe(MEASURES[kind].target);
    // Only the three timed kinds sign their days and whether they are announced.
    expect(TIMED_KINDS).toEqual(["suspend", "terminate", "restrict_reporting"]);
  });

  test("each has a label of its own: the composer's words where the composer names the measure", () => {
    // The first seven and "Lift the seal" are the words of the decision composer; the composer, the statement and the
    // terms all take them from here. 3e's are W.1's.
    expect(Object.fromEntries(kinds.map((kind) => [kind, MEASURES[kind].label]))).toEqual({
      withhold: "Withhold the post",
      remove: "Remove",
      seal_media: "Seal the images this case reaches",
      withhold_media: "Withhold one image",
      remove_media: "Remove one image",
      reset_display_name: "Reset display name",
      reset_bio: "Reset bio",
      restore: "Lift the restriction of the post",
      unseal_media: "Lift the seal",
      restore_media: "Lift the restriction of one image",
      restore_display_name: "Lift the reset of the display name",
      restore_bio: "Lift the reset of the bio",
      strike: "Strike",
      suspend: "Suspend the account",
      terminate: "Terminate the account",
      retire_handle: "Retire the handle",
      warn_reporting: "Warn about reporting",
      restrict_reporting: "Restrict reporting",
      overrule: "Overrule the strike",
      lift_suspension: "Lift the suspension",
      unretire_handle: "Give the handle back",
      lift_reporting: "Lift the reporting measure",
      // 3f (W.1).
      disable_by_order: "Disabled for an order",
      reinstate_by_order: "Reinstate after an order",
    });
    const labels = kinds.map((kind) => MEASURES[kind].label);
    expect(new Set(labels).size).toBe(labels.length);
  });
});

describe("the order of a decision's actions", () => {
  const a = "1a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
  const b = "2a1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";

  test("by kind as a string, then by image as a string, an action without an image first", () => {
    const sorted: DecisionActionParams[] = [
      { kind: "remove", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: a },
      { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: b },
      { kind: "reset_bio", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: a },
    ];
    for (const shuffled of [[...sorted].reverse(), [sorted[3]!, sorted[0]!, sorted[5]!, sorted[2]!, sorted[1]!, sorted[4]!]]) {
      expect([...shuffled].sort(compareDecisionActions)).toEqual(sorted);
    }
    expect(compareDecisionActions(sorted[1]!, sorted[1]!)).toBe(0);
    expect(compareDecisionActions({ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: a })).toBeLessThan(0);
  });
});

describe("textDigest", () => {
  test("the tag names the version of the rule", () => {
    expect(TEXT_DIGEST_TAG).toBe("korbat.text.v1");
  });

  test.each(TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => [vector.name, vector] as const))("%s: the sha256 of the tag, a line feed, the salt's bytes and the text's UTF-8 bytes", async (_name, vector) => {
    expect(await textDigest(vector.salt, vector.text)).toBe(vector.digest);
  });

  test("the longest vector is 5000 UTF-16 units, and the vectors hold a line feed, a character outside ASCII and one outside the basic plane", () => {
    expect(Math.max(...TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => vector.text.length))).toBe(5000);
    const all = TEXT_DIGEST_VECTORS.map((vector) => vector.text).join("");
    expect(all).toContain(LF);
    expect(all).toContain(E_ACUTE);
    expect(all).toContain(GRINNING);
  });

  test("another salt or another text gives another digest", async () => {
    const digests = await Promise.all([textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "one"), textDigest("a2".repeat(32), "one"), textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "one "), textDigest("a1".repeat(32), "One")]);
    expect(new Set(digests).size).toBe(4);
  });

  test("a salt that is not 32 bytes of lower-case hex is refused, never padded or folded", async () => {
    for (const salt of ["", "a1".repeat(31), "a1".repeat(33), "A1".repeat(32), "g1".repeat(32), ` ${"a1".repeat(32)}`]) {
      await expect(textDigest(salt, "text"), JSON.stringify(salt)).rejects.toThrow(TypeError);
    }
  });

  test("a text with a lone surrogate, which has no UTF-8 bytes, is refused rather than hashed as something else", async () => {
    const high = String.fromCharCode(0xd83d);
    const low = String.fromCharCode(0xde00);
    for (const text of [high, low, `a${high}b`, `${low}${high}`]) await expect(textDigest("a1".repeat(32), text)).rejects.toThrow(TypeError);
    // The pair itself is a character.
    await expect(textDigest("a1".repeat(32), `${high}${low}`)).resolves.toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
  });
});

describe("snapshotText and snapshotDigest", () => {
  const post: SnapshotDigestInput = {
    salt: "ab".repeat(32),
    targetType: "post",
    targetId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a",
    takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.123Z",
    authorHandle: "ada",
    postState: "visible",
    postCreatedAt: "2026-10-01T08:30:00.000Z",
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36",
    body: `Line one${LF}caf${E_ACUTE} ${GRINNING}`,
    media: [
      { id: "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555", alt: "A cat", width: 1200, height: 800 },
      { id: "66666666-7777-4888-9999-aaaaaaaaaaaa", alt: null, width: 640, height: 480 },
    ],
    displayName: null,
    bio: null,
    handle: null,
  };
  const account: SnapshotDigestInput = {
    salt: "cd".repeat(32),
    targetType: "account",
    targetId: "8a3c7f0e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666",
    takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.000Z",
    authorHandle: "bob",
    postState: null,
    postCreatedAt: null,
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: null,
    body: null,
    media: null,
    displayName: `Bob ${GRINNING}`,
    bio: "",
    handle: "bob",
  };
  const BS = String.fromCharCode(92);
  // The texts and the digests below were computed with Python's json and hashlib when they were written.
  const POST_TEXT =
    `{"authorHandle":"ada","bio":null,"body":"Line one${BS}ncaf${E_ACUTE} ${GRINNING}","displayName":null,"handle":null,` +
    `"media":[{"alt":"A cat","height":800,"id":"11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555","width":1200},{"alt":null,"height":480,"id":"66666666-7777-4888-9999-aaaaaaaaaaaa","width":640}],` +
    `"postCreatedAt":"2026-10-01T08:30:00.000Z","postState":"visible","quoteOfId":"7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36","replyToId":null,` +
    `"salt":"${"ab".repeat(32)}","takenAt":"2026-10-03T10:00:00.123Z","targetId":"3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a","targetType":"post","v":1}`;
  const POST_DIGEST = "cb995d11ed14e3c4e555c187d319a86506b263e98f924f59f2f7d5231a3bc6e6";
  const ACCOUNT_DIGEST = "41019b2a47d4ebad37cc8c5ad25f8d79a7232c4e3e705231f9e9ba1e02fb1f26";

  test("the tag names the version of the rule", () => {
    expect(SNAPSHOT_DIGEST_TAG).toBe("korbat.snapshot.v1");
  });

  test("the text is the sorted JSON of version 1 and the snapshot's fifteen members", () => {
    expect(snapshotText(post)).toBe(POST_TEXT);
    const parsed = JSON.parse(snapshotText(account)) as Record<string, unknown>;
    expect(Object.keys(parsed)).toEqual(["authorHandle", "bio", "body", "displayName", "handle", "media", "postCreatedAt", "postState", "quoteOfId", "replyToId", "salt", "takenAt", "targetId", "targetType", "v"]);
    expect(parsed).toEqual({ v: 1, ...account });
  });

  test("the digest is the sha256 of the tag, a line feed and that text", async () => {
    expect(await snapshotDigest(post)).toBe(POST_DIGEST);
    expect(await snapshotDigest(account)).toBe(ACCOUNT_DIGEST);
  });

  test("it round-trips the snapshot answer's JSON, whatever order and whatever else the answer carries", async () => {
    // As the console receives it: parsed from JSON, with members the digest does not cover, in another order.
    const sent = {
      id: "9d0f5e3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
      digest: POST_DIGEST,
      withheld: false,
      erasedAt: null,
      ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(post).reverse()),
      media: post.media!.map((image) => ({ height: image.height, width: image.width, note: "never part of a snapshot", alt: image.alt, id: image.id })),
    };
    const answer = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sent)) as SnapshotDigestInput;
    expect(snapshotText(answer)).toBe(POST_TEXT);
    expect(await snapshotDigest(answer)).toBe(POST_DIGEST);
  });

  test("any member that changes gives another digest", async () => {
    const changed: SnapshotDigestInput[] = [
      { ...post, salt: "ac".repeat(32) },
      { ...post, takenAt: "2026-10-03T10:00:00.124Z" },
      { ...post, body: `${post.body} ` },
      { ...post, postState: "withheld" },
      { ...post, quoteOfId: null },
      { ...post, media: [post.media![1]!, post.media![0]!] },
      { ...post, media: [{ ...post.media![0]!, alt: "A dog" }, post.media![1]!] },
      { ...post, authorHandle: "adb" },
    ];
    const digests = await Promise.all([post, ...changed].map(snapshotDigest));
    expect(new Set(digests).size).toBe(changed.length + 1);
  });

  test("a time that is not the UTC string toISOString writes, to the millisecond, is refused", () => {
    for (const takenAt of ["2026-10-03T10:00:00Z", "2026-10-03T10:00:00.123456Z", "2026-10-03T12:00:00.123+02:00", "2026-10-03 10:00:00.123Z", ""]) {
      expect(() => snapshotText({ ...post, takenAt }), takenAt).toThrow(TypeError);
    }
    expect(() => snapshotText({ ...post, postCreatedAt: "2026-10-01T08:30:00Z" })).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(snapshotText({ ...post, takenAt: new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 3, 10, 0, 0, 123)).toISOString() })).toBe(POST_TEXT);
  });
});

describe("appealDeadline", () => {
  const at = (iso: string) => new Date(iso);
  const deadline = (iso: string) => appealDeadline(at(iso)).toISOString();

  test("six calendar months later, at the same UTC time", () => {
    expect(deadline("2026-10-03T10:15:30.250Z")).toBe("2027-04-03T10:15:30.250Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-01-15T00:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-07-15T00:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-07-01T23:59:59.999Z")).toBe("2027-01-01T23:59:59.999Z");
  });

  test("a day the sixth month lacks becomes that month's last day", () => {
    // 31 August plus six months is the end of February: the 28th, or the 29th in a leap year.
    expect(deadline("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-02-28T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-31T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-30T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2027-08-29T12:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-02-29T12:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-03-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-09-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-05-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2026-11-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-10-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-04-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-12-31T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-06-30T08:00:00.000Z");
    // A leap day itself moves to 29 August: August has the day.
    expect(deadline("2028-02-29T08:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2028-08-29T08:00:00.000Z");
  });

  test("it is computed in UTC: the last instants of a UTC month stay on that month's side", () => {
    expect(deadline("2026-08-31T23:59:59.999Z")).toBe("2027-02-28T23:59:59.999Z");
    expect(deadline("2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z")).toBe("2027-03-01T00:00:00.000Z");
  });

  test("it leaves its argument as it was", () => {
    const informed = at("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z");
    appealDeadline(informed);
    expect(informed.toISOString()).toBe("2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z");
  });
});

  SourceSummary,
  StaffOverview,
  StaffSnapshotTaken,
  StaffTextSaveRequest,
  StaffTextSaved,
  StaffTextsResponse,
  TDB_CATEGORIES,
  reporterLabel,
  snapshotDigest,
  staffTextProblem,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * The console's requests and answers on cases (3c design, section 10): what a moderator's own finding may say, what a
 * saved text must be, and the shapes the queue, the case and the home screen are parsed with.
 */

const CASE = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
const POST = "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36";
const OTHER = "5b0e4a52-3c1d-4f6e-9a8b-7c6d5e4f3a2b";
const HEX = "ab".repeat(32);
const TIME = "2026-10-04T08:15:30.123Z";
/** The seven members of 3e on a ledger row of 3c, where each is null. */
const NO_STANDING_COLUMNS = { days: null, announced: null, basis: null, restsOn: null, earliestStart: null, countsUntil: null, period: null, restedOnBy: null, reply: null } as const;

describe("FindingRequest", () => {
  const finding = { target: { kind: "post", id: POST }, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" };

  test("a moderator's finding cites a korbat rule, R2 among them, about a post, an account or a korbat link", () => {
    for (const ruleId of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId }).success, ruleId).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.parse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).target).toEqual({ kind: "account", handle: "some_one" });
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "link", url: "https://korbat.example/post/" + POST } }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("it has no other ground than a rule: a finding never alleges illegality and never goes the path that records no sender", () => {
    for (const ground of ["illegal", "csam", "order", "law", ""]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ground }).success, ground).toBe(false);
    const { ground: _ground, ...withoutGround } = finding;
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse(withoutGround).success).toBe(false);
    // The members of the other grounds are refused, never ignored.
    for (const extra of [{ explanation: "words" }, { bonaFide: true }, { citedLaw: "a law" }, { keyword: "csam" }, { name: "A" }, { email: "a@b.example" }, { turnstileToken: "t" }]) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ...extra }).success, Object.keys(extra)[0]).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: "R7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its category is one of the Transparency Database's, but not the one that says a notifier was not sure", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success, category).toBe(category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE");
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the categories a finding may carry are exported as a list, in the Transparency Database's order, for the console's form: exactly those the request takes", () => {
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toEqual(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE"));
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toHaveLength(TDB_CATEGORIES.length - 1);
    expect(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success)).toEqual(FINDING_CATEGORIES);
  });

  test("the answer names the case the finding opened or joined", () => {
    expect(FindingResponse.parse({ caseId: CASE })).toEqual({ caseId: CASE });
    expect(FindingResponse.safeParse({ caseId: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("a saved text", () => {
  const save = { kind: "note", text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion", salt: HEX, digest: HEX };

  test("is of one of the seven kinds, the recorded choice not to seal among them, with a 32-byte salt and a digest in lower-case hex", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_KINDS).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason", "reveal_reason", "note", "seal_declined"]);
    for (const kind of STAFF_TEXT_KINDS) expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind: "statement" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [HEX.toUpperCase(), HEX.slice(2), `${HEX}00`, "", "g".repeat(64)]) {
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, salt: bad }).success, `salt ${bad}`).toBe(false);
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, digest: bad }).success, `digest ${bad}`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, caseId: CASE }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the request's schema lets any text through: what a text must be is the route's to refuse, with a code of its own", () => {
    // A text that is too long or holds a control character is answered text_invalid, not invalid_request.
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: "x".repeat(STAFF_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: `a${String.fromCharCode(7)}b` }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("staffTextProblem: a well-formed text of at most 5000 UTF-16 units, with no control character but the line feed and no invisible direction or zero-width character", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_MAX).toBe(5000);
    const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
    expect(staffTextProblem(`two${LF}lines`)).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("")).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5000))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5001))).toBe("too_long");
    // An emoji is two units: 2500 of them fit, and one more unit does not.
    const emoji = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(staffTextProblem(emoji.repeat(2500))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`${emoji.repeat(2500)}x`)).toBe("too_long");
    // Half of a surrogate pair has no UTF-8 bytes.
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xd83d)}b`)).toBe("malformed");
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xde00)}`)).toBe("malformed");
    // NUL and every other C0 control but the line feed.
    for (let code = 0; code < 32; code++) {
      expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe(code === 10 ? null : "control");
    }
    // The invisible direction and spacing characters the notice texts refuse too; the joiners scripts and emoji need stay.
    for (const code of [0x202a, 0x202e, 0x2066, 0x2069, 0x200b, 0x2060, 0xfeff]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe("format");
    for (const code of [0x200c, 0x200d]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`r${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}sum${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the answers: the stored text's id and digest, the person's own drafts with their salts, and a snapshot's id and digest, never content", () => {
    expect(StaffTextSaved.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX })).toEqual({ id: CASE, digest: HEX });
    const draft = { id: CASE, kind: "facts", text: "The post names a home address.", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME };
    expect(StaffTextsResponse.parse({ texts: [draft] }).texts).toEqual([draft]);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffSnapshotTaken.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX, body: "content", media: [] }))).toEqual(["id", "digest"]);
  });
});

describe("the reveal", () => {
  test("its request is the confirmed params with the key's assertion, and nothing else", () => {
    const stepUp = { id: "Y3JlZA", rawId: "Y3JlZA", type: "public-key", response: { clientDataJSON: "e30", authenticatorData: "AAAA", signature: "AAAA" }, clientExtensionResults: {} };
    const params = { reasonCategory: "impersonation_claim", reasonDigest: HEX };
    expect(IdentityRevealRequest.safeParse({ ...params, stepUp }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(IdentityRevealRequest.safeParse(params).success).toBe(false);
    expect(IdentityRevealRequest.safeParse({ ...params, stepUp, reason: "free text" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(IdentityRevealRequest.safeParse({ ...params, reasonCategory: "curiosity", stepUp }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its answer is a reporter's handle or a notifier's given name, or neither when the name was forgotten in between; never an address", () => {
    expect(RevealResponse.parse({ handle: "some_one", name: null })).toEqual({ handle: "some_one", name: null });
    expect(RevealResponse.parse({ handle: null, name: "Ada" })).toEqual({ handle: null, name: "Ada" });
    expect(RevealResponse.parse({ handle: null, name: null })).toEqual({ handle: null, name: null });
    expect(Object.keys(RevealResponse.parse({ handle: null, name: "Ada", email: "ada@example.org" }))).toEqual(["handle", "name"]);
  });
});

describe("a source's summary", () => {
  const reporter = { kind: "reporter", label: "Reporter A", accountAge: "1_to_12_months", itemsFiled: "2_to_9", actedOn: "under_half", answeredUnseen: "none", named: null, contactGiven: null, confirmed: null, suppressed: null, contactLost: false };

  test("names nobody: a letter given per case, bands instead of counts, and for a notifier what was given, never what", () => {
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse(reporter).success).toBe(true);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind: "notifier", label: SOURCE_LABELS.notifier, accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null, named: true, contactGiven: true, confirmed: false, suppressed: false }).success).toBe(true);
    for (const kind of ["anonymous", "staff", "unlinked"] as const) {
      expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind, label: SOURCE_LABELS[kind], accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    }
    // Bands only: an exact count is no value of any of them.
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, itemsFiled: "7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, actedOn: "0.4" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, answeredUnseen: "3" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, accountAge: "3_days" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its label is one of the console's own: a reporter's letter or the fixed words of its kind, never a text an answer could choose", () => {
    expect(reporterLabel(0)).toBe("Reporter A");
    expect(reporterLabel(1)).toBe("Reporter B");
    expect(reporterLabel(25)).toBe("Reporter Z");
    expect(reporterLabel(26)).toBe("Reporter AA");
    expect(reporterLabel(27)).toBe("Reporter AB");
    expect(reporterLabel(26 + 26 * 26)).toBe("Reporter AAA");
    for (const label of ["korbat: verified notice from police", "Reporter a", "Reporter", "Reporter A ", "<b>Reporter A</b>", SOURCE_LABELS.staff]) {
      expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, label }).success, label).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(SourceSummary.safeParse({ ...reporter, kind: "staff", label: "Reporter A" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the case answer", () => {
  const summary = { kind: "anonymous", label: SOURCE_LABELS.anonymous, accountAge: null, itemsFiled: null, actedOn: null, answeredUnseen: null, named: null, contactGiven: null, confirmed: null, suppressed: null, contactLost: false };
  const shown = {
    id: OTHER,
    takenAt: TIME,
    digest: HEX,
    withheld: false,
    salt: HEX,
    targetType: "post",
    targetId: POST,
    authorHandle: "author",
    postState: "visible",
    postCreatedAt: TIME,
    replyToId: null,
    quoteOfId: null,
    body: "the post's words",
    media: [{ id: OTHER, alt: "an image", width: 1200, height: 800 }],
    displayName: null,
    bio: null,
    handle: null,
  };
  const view = {
    id: CASE,
    lane: 0,
    stateVersion: 2,
    intakeSeq: 2,
    answeredSeq: 0,
    openedAt: TIME,
    closedAt: null,
    target: { type: "post", id: POST, link: `https://korbat.example/post/${POST}`, authorHandle: "author", state: "visible", level: "visible" },
    suspicion: { open: true, reach: { posts: 1, images: 1, sealed: 0, served: 1, newestPostOn: "2026-09-04" }, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: null, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 1, lastOn: "2026-08-01" } } },
    imagesAllowed: false,
    snapshots: [shown, { id: CASE, takenAt: TIME, digest: HEX, withheld: true }],
    items: [
      {
        id: OTHER,
        seq: 1,
        position: 1,
        createdAt: TIME,
        lane: 0,
        link: `https://korbat.example/post/${POST}`,
        ruleId: null,
        allegesIllegal: true,
        csam: true,
        category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
        categoryKeyword: "KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL",
        citedLaw: null,
        explanation: "a notifier's words",
        mediaId: null,
        suspect: true,
        quotedByPosition: null,
        quotedCaseId: CASE,
        reexaminesPosition: null,
        reexaminesYourDecision: false,
        statement: null,
        outcome: null,
        answeredBy: null,
        erased: false,
        source: summary,
        markable: false,
        unfounded: false,
        markWithdrawn: false,
        // 3d Task 8 ([case.sameSource]): the reporter's other open items.
        sameSourceOpen: 0,
      },
    ],
    decisions: [
      {
        id: OTHER,
        kind: "interim",
        outcome: "restricted",
        ground: "incompatible",
        ruleId: "R2",
        rulesVersion: 2,
        redressVersion: 1,
        category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS",
        categoryKeyword: null,
        source: "notice",
        decidedAt: TIME,
        staffHandle: "mod_anna",
        byProgram: false,
        matchAnswerReason: null,
        throughSeq: 0,
        answersFromSeq: null,
        reviewsDecisionId: null,
        snapshotId: OTHER,
        suspect: true,
        unseen: false,
        needsAdmin: false,
        endedInterim: false,
        facts: "what was found",
        reason: "why",
        legalReference: null,
        actions: [
          { id: CASE, kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, inForce: true, reversesActionId: null, liftedBy: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 1, deletedPosts: 0, list: [{ postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 }] }, ...NO_STANDING_COLUMNS },
        ],
      },
    ],
    appeals: [{ id: OTHER, decisionId: OTHER, filedAt: TIME, statement: "the author's words", answeredAt: null, result: null, answeredBy: null, reviewer: "available", needsAdmin: false, mayReview: true }],
    drafts: [{ id: OTHER, kind: "reason", text: "a draft", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME }],
    notes: [{ id: OTHER, staffHandle: "mod_anna", createdAt: TIME, text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion" }],
    sealsDeclined: [{ id: CASE, staffHandle: "mod_anna", createdAt: TIME, text: "The report repeats the one answered yesterday." }],
    history: [
      { at: TIME, event: "item", refId: OTHER, seq: 1, intakeKind: "user", ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: true, csam: true, reexamination: false, decisionKind: null, outcome: null, staffHandle: null, result: null },
      { at: TIME, event: "decision", refId: OTHER, seq: null, intakeKind: null, ruleId: null, allegesIllegal: null, csam: null, reexamination: null, decisionKind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", staffHandle: "mod_anna", result: null },
    ],
    strikeDue: { due: true, why: "due" },
    authorStanding: { activeStrikes: "0", suspensionsInYear: "0", now: "none" },
    standing: null,
    // 3f Task 3: the post is not preserved for an order, and no order's notice about it is held.
    preserved: false,
    noticeHeld: null,
    orderErasedOn: null,
    // 3f Task 5: since when a report to the authorities is owed for the case; none here.
    reportOwed: null,
    // 3d Task 3: no image of the newest snapshot stopped being public.
    purges: [],
    signals: [],
    objection: null,
    matchedImages: [],
    // 3d Task 8 ([case.flag]).
    flag: null,
  };

  test("parses a case with its target, suspicion, snapshots, items, decisions, appeals, texts and history", () => {
    const parsed = CaseView.parse(view);
    expect(parsed.snapshots).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(parsed.items[0]!.source.kind).toBe("anonymous");
    expect(parsed.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!.sealed?.list).toEqual([{ postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 }]);
    // An account's case: its live fields, no suspicion, and never an image.
    const account = { ...view, target: { type: "account", id: POST, handle: "now_named", displayName: "A name", bio: "A bio", deleted: false }, suspicion: null, snapshots: [], items: [], decisions: [] };
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(account).success).toBe(true);
    // A target whose row is gone is still an answer: staff see what is.
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, target: { type: "post", id: POST, link: `https://korbat.example/post/${POST}`, authorHandle: null, state: null, level: null } }).success).toBe(true);
  });


  test("3e: a post case carries whether a strike is due and the author's standing in bands; an account case the account's standing", () => {
    for (const why of ["due", "already_struck", "before_last_strike"] as const) expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, strikeDue: { due: why === "due", why } }).success, why).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, strikeDue: { due: true, why: "maybe" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, authorStanding: { activeStrikes: "3", suspensionsInYear: "0", now: "none" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, authorStanding: { activeStrikes: "3_or_more", suspensionsInYear: "2_or_more", now: "terminated" } }).success).toBe(true);
    const standing = {
      activeStrikes: 3,
      strikes: [{ decisionId: OTHER, caseId: CASE, ruleId: "R3", decidedAt: TIME, countsUntil: TIME }],
      ladderRule: "R3",
      suspensionsInYear: 0,
      lastSuspendedOn: null,
      maxDays: 3,
      mayTerminate: false,
      live: false,
      openReports: true,
      atOnce: ["threat"],
      flood: { posts: 2, from: TIME, to: TIME },
      seal: { decidedOn: "2026-10-01" },
      snapshotHandleRetired: false,
      // 3e Task 3: the decision each ground of a suspension at once would rest on now, by its time.
      basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME, terrorist: null, protective: TIME },
      // 3e Task 5: the account's record of reporting, in reports.
      reporting: { reports: 0, unfounded: 0, warnedOn: null, warnedAt: null, marksSince: null, mayWarn: false, mayRestrict: false, restrictedUntil: null, marked: [] },
    };
    const account = { ...view, target: { type: "account", id: POST, handle: "now_named", displayName: "A name", bio: "A bio", deleted: false }, suspicion: null, snapshots: [], items: [], decisions: [], strikeDue: null, authorStanding: null, standing };
    expect(CaseView.parse(account).standing).toEqual(standing);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, maxDays: 31 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, atOnce: ["ladder"] } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
    // A decision says which standing measures rest on it, when any does; older answers carry no such member.
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) {
      expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }]);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "spam" }] }] }).success).toBe(false);
    }
    // Each member is always there: on the other kind of case it is null.
    const { standing: _standing, ...without } = account;
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(without).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3e: a ledger row carries its days, whether it is announced, its basis, what it rests on, its earliest start, its end of counting and its period", () => {
    const action = view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!;
    const strike = { ...action, kind: "strike", sealed: null, countsUntil: TIME };
    const suspend = { ...action, kind: "suspend", sealed: null, days: 3, announced: true, basis: "strikes", restsOn: [OTHER], earliestStart: TIME, period: { startsAt: null, endsAt: null, state: "unfixed" } };
    for (const row of [strike, suspend]) expect(CaseDecisionAction.parse(row)).toEqual(row);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, basis: "ladder" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, period: { ...suspend.period, state: "paused" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, days: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
    const { period: _period, ...withoutPeriod } = suspend;
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse(withoutPeriod).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3e Task 5: each item says whether it can be marked and whether its mark counts or was withdrawn; an account case carries its record of reporting in reports, by reference and never by person", () => {
    const item = view.items[0]!;
    for (const member of ["markable", "unfounded", "markWithdrawn"] as const) {
      const { [member]: _gone, ...without } = item;
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [without] }).success, member).toBe(false);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, [member]: null }] }).success, member).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, markable: true, unfounded: true }] }).items[0]).toMatchObject({ markable: true, unfounded: true, markWithdrawn: false });
    const reporting = {
      reports: 8,
      unfounded: 5,
      warnedOn: "2026-09-01",
      warnedAt: TIME,
      marksSince: 2,
      mayWarn: false,
      mayRestrict: false,
      restrictedUntil: null,
      marked: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGHIJ", position: 2, sentOn: "2026-08-30", markedOn: "2026-08-31", sinceWarning: false }],
    };
    const parsed = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting.parse(reporting);
    expect(parsed).toEqual(reporting);
    const Reporting = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting;
    // A marked report is named by its reference and the item's place in it, never by who sent it.
    expect(Object.keys(Reporting.shape.marked.element.shape).sort()).toEqual(["markedOn", "position", "ref", "sentOn", "sinceWarning"]);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, marked: [{ ...reporting.marked[0], ref: "someone" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, unfounded: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, restrictedUntil: "2026-10-01" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A restriction of reporting rests on its warning: the warning's decision says so, for [review.warning].
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }]);
  });

  test("a withheld snapshot carries its id, time and digest and no content, whatever the answer held", () => {
    const withheld = CaseSnapshot.parse({ ...shown, withheld: true });
    expect(Object.keys(withheld).sort()).toEqual(["digest", "id", "takenAt", "withheld"]);
  });

  test("a snapshot that is shown carries everything its digest covers: the console recomputes the digest from the answer", async () => {
    const parsed = CaseSnapshot.parse(shown);
    if (parsed.withheld) throw new Error("the snapshot is shown");
    const expected = await snapshotDigest({ ...shown, targetType: "post", postState: "visible" });
    expect(await snapshotDigest(parsed)).toBe(expected);
    const { salt: _salt, ...withoutSalt } = shown;
    expect(CaseSnapshot.safeParse(withoutSalt).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a seal's list holds at most the 500 rows the case answer carries", () => {
    const row = { postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 };
    const withList = (rows: number) => ({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!, actions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!, sealed: { posts: rows, images: rows, deletedPosts: 0, list: Array.from({ length: rows }, () => row) } }] }] });
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(500)).success).toBe(true);

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { actionKind } from "../src/schema/moderation";

/**
 * The rule for the new values of action_kind (3e design, section 6, "The rule for the new enum values"; invariant 1).
 * drizzle's migrator runs every pending migration in one transaction, and a value that ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE added
 * cannot be used as an enum literal before that transaction commits (SQLSTATE 55P04) in anything that is parsed when it
 * is created or run: a view, an SQL-language function, a check, a default, an index predicate, a plain statement. Only a
 * PL/pgSQL body is parsed when it is first called, which no migration statement does. So in 3e's migrations a new value
 * appears as a literal only inside a PL/pgSQL function's body, and everywhere else a kind is compared as text
 * (`kind::text = 'strike'`). This test reads 3e's migration files and refuses any other use.
 *
 * The SQL is read statement by statement, its comments dropped, and every run of white space made one space, so the
 * patterns below need no escapes.
 */

const MIGRATIONS = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "../migrations");

/** 3c's twelve kinds come first in the enum; 3e's ten follow them, and 3f's two follow those (read below). */
const OLD_KINDS = 12;
const KINDS_3E = 10;
const NEW_KINDS: readonly string[] = actionKind.enumValues.slice(OLD_KINDS, OLD_KINDS + KINDS_3E);

/** 3e's first migration: 3c ended at 0019_redaction_scope, so 3e's migrations are 0020 and after. */
const FIRST_3E_MIGRATION = 20;

const NEWLINE = String.fromCharCode(10);
const BREAKPOINT = "--> statement-breakpoint";

/** The journal's entries of 3e's migrations, oldest first. */
function migrationsOf3e(): { idx: number; tag: string }[] {
  const journal = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path.join(MIGRATIONS, "meta", "_journal.json"), "utf8")) as { entries: { idx: number; tag: string }[] };
  return journal.entries.filter((entry) => entry.idx >= FIRST_3E_MIGRATION);
}

/** A statement with its line comments dropped: a comment may name a kind in any words it likes. */
function withoutComments(statement: string): string {
  return statement
    .split(NEWLINE)
    .map((line) => {
      const at = line.indexOf("--");
      return at < 0 ? line : line.slice(0, at);
    })
    .join(NEWLINE);
}

/** Every run of white space (a code point up to the space) as one space, trimmed. */
function flat(text: string): string {
  return [...text]
    .map((char) => (char.charCodeAt(0) <= 32 ? " " : char))
    .join("")
    .split(" ")
    .filter((word) => word !== "")
    .join(" ");
}

/**
 * A statement with the body of a PL/pgSQL function blanked, so that only what is parsed at once is left: a statement that
 * creates a function in LANGUAGE plpgsql keeps its signature and loses what lies between its outer dollar quotes. A DO
 * block keeps its body: it runs inside the migration, and its literals are parsed then.
 */
function withoutPlpgsqlBody(statement: string): string {
  const upper = statement.toUpperCase();
  const creates = upper.startsWith("CREATE FUNCTION") || upper.startsWith("CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION");
  if (!creates || !upper.includes("LANGUAGE PLPGSQL")) return statement;
  const open = statement.indexOf("$$");
  const close = statement.lastIndexOf("$$");
  if (open < 0 || close <= open) return statement;
  return `${statement.slice(0, open + 2)} ${statement.slice(close)}`;
}

/**
 * The places where a literal is compared as text: `::text` followed by `=`, `<>`, `IN (` or `= ANY (ARRAY[` and then a
 * list of quoted words. A new kind's literal there is a text, and parses whatever the enum holds.
 */
const TEXT_COMPARISON = /::text ?(?:=|<>|!=|in ?[(]|= ?any ?[(] ?array ?[[]) ?'[a-z_]+'(?: ?, ?'[a-z_]+')*/gi;

/** The statement that adds a value names it, as a label and not as a literal of the enum. */
const ADDED_VALUE = /alter type [^ ]+ add value '[a-z_]+'/gi;

/** Every use of a new kind's literal in the SQL that is outside a PL/pgSQL body and not compared as text, each with its context. */
function enumLiteralViolations(sqlText: string, kinds: readonly string[] = NEW_KINDS): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  const literal = new RegExp(`'(${kinds.join("|")})'`, "g");
  for (const statement of sqlText.split(BREAKPOINT)) {
    const scanned = withoutPlpgsqlBody(flat(withoutComments(statement)));
    const allowed: [number, number][] = [];
    for (const pattern of [TEXT_COMPARISON, ADDED_VALUE]) {
      for (const match of scanned.matchAll(pattern)) allowed.push([match.index, match.index + match[0].length]);
    }
    for (const match of scanned.matchAll(literal)) {
      const at = match.index;
      const castToText = /^ ?::text(?![a-z_])/i.test(scanned.slice(at + match[0].length));
      if (castToText || allowed.some(([from, to]) => at >= from && at < to)) continue;
      violations.push(scanned.slice(Math.max(0, at - 60), at + match[0].length + 20));
    }
  }
  return violations;
}

describe("the enum-literal rule of 3e's migrations", () => {
  test("action_kind's new values are the ten of 3e, after 3c's twelve", () => {
    expect(NEW_KINDS).toEqual(["strike", "suspend", "terminate", "retire_handle", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting", "overrule", "lift_suspension", "unretire_handle", "lift_reporting"]);
  });

  test("3e's migrations are there: the schema (0020) and standing_ledger (0021) at least", () => {
    const tags = migrationsOf3e().map((entry) => entry.tag);
    expect(tags.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    expect(tags[1]).toBe("0021_standing_ledger");
  });

  test("no file of 3e names a new kind as a literal outside a PL/pgSQL body", () => {
    for (const entry of migrationsOf3e()) {
      const text = readFileSync(path.join(MIGRATIONS, `${entry.tag}.sql`), "utf8");
      expect(enumLiteralViolations(text), entry.tag).toEqual([]);
    }
  });

  test("the files of 3e do name the new kinds, inside PL/pgSQL bodies, so the test reads what it should", () => {
    const ledger = readFileSync(path.join(MIGRATIONS, `${migrationsOf3e()[1]!.tag}.sql`), "utf8");
    // The same file read without blanking the bodies would hold many: the bodies are where the kinds are used.
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(ledger.split("LANGUAGE plpgsql").join("LANGUAGE sql")).length).toBeGreaterThan(20);
  });

  test("a deliberate violation of each kind is caught, and the allowed forms are not", () => {
    // Caught: a view, an SQL function, a check and an index predicate that name a new kind as the enum, and a cast.
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT 1 FROM decision_actions a WHERE a.kind = 'strike';`)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql AS $$ SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decision_actions a WHERE a.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate')) $$;`)).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`ALTER TABLE decision_actions ADD CONSTRAINT c CHECK (kind <> 'overrule');`)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`CREATE INDEX i ON decision_actions (created_at) WHERE kind = 'strike';`)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`SELECT 'lift_reporting'::public.action_kind;`)).toHaveLength(1);
    // A DO block runs inside the migration: its body is no exemption.
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`DO $$ BEGIN PERFORM 1 FROM decision_actions a WHERE a.kind = 'strike'; END $$;`)).toHaveLength(1);
    // Two statements: the second's violation is found although the first is a PL/pgSQL function.
    const two = `CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN PERFORM 1; END $$;${BREAKPOINT}${NEWLINE}CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT 1 FROM decision_actions a WHERE a.kind = 'suspend';`;
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(two)).toHaveLength(1);
    // Allowed: a comparison as text, a cast to text, any literal inside a PL/pgSQL body, an old kind, a comment, and the
    // statement that adds the value.
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT 1 FROM decision_actions a WHERE a.kind::text = 'strike' AND a.kind::text IN ('suspend', 'terminate');`)).toEqual([]);
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT 'strike'::text AS k;`)).toEqual([]);
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`CREATE FUNCTION f() RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN PERFORM 1 FROM decision_actions a WHERE a.kind = 'strike'; END $$;`)).toEqual([]);
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`CREATE VIEW v AS SELECT 1 FROM decision_actions a WHERE a.kind = 'remove';`)).toEqual([]);
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`-- a.kind = 'strike' in a comment${NEWLINE}SELECT 1;`)).toEqual([]);
    expect(enumLiteralViolations(`ALTER TYPE "public"."action_kind" ADD VALUE 'strike';`)).toEqual([]);
  });
});

/**

const VALUES_3F: readonly string[] = ["disable_by_order", "reinstate_by_order", "order", "authority", "disabled"];

function migrationsFromOrders(): { idx: number; tag: string }[] {
