```tsx
import { FINDING_CATEGORIES, FindingRequest, REPLY_AIM_HOURS, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, RULE_IDS, type QueueReply, type QueueRow, type RuleId, type TdbCategory } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { getRule } from "@korbat/rules";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { systemClock, type Clock } from "../idle";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS, describeError, FINDING_WORDS, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId } from "../router";
import { dateTime, Loaded, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import { categoryLabel, counted, LANE_NAMES, waited } from "../words";

/**
 * The queue (3c design, sections 7.3 and 8): open cases by lane and then by age, as the API orders them. Nothing here
 * weighs a case: no count of reports, no standing of a reporter. The page reads the queue again every 60 seconds without
 * the activity mark, so a queue left open never keeps a staff session alive. Beside it, "Open a case" takes a korbat link
 * on the moderator's own finding.
 */

/** How often the queue reads itself again. */
export const QUEUE_REFRESH_MS = 60_000;

/**
 * The screen's reads of the queue, on a clock that is the page's or a test's (as the idle timer's is): one now, marked,
 * since opening the screen is its person's action, and one every QUEUE_REFRESH_MS after it, unmarked, since those are the
 * page's own and must never move the session's idle end. Answers what ends them, for when the screen is left.
 */
export function startQueueReads(clock: Clock, read: (activity: boolean) => void): () => void {
  let handle: unknown = null;
  let ended = false;
  const refresh = () => {
    if (ended) return;
    read(false);
    handle = clock.setTimeout(refresh, QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
  };
  read(true);
  handle = clock.setTimeout(refresh, QUEUE_REFRESH_MS);
  return () => {
    ended = true;
    clock.clearTimeout(handle);
  };
}

/** What marks a row beyond its lane and age: the console's own words for what its unanswered items are. */
export function marksOf(row: QueueRow): string[] {
  const marks: string[] = [];
  if (row.allegesIllegal) marks.push("notice under Art. 16");
  if (row.suspect) marks.push("CSAM: no images");
  if (row.reexamination) marks.push("re-examination");
  if (row.deferred) marks.push("deferred");
  // 3d Task 6 (section 8.3): what a program found and took on the case, and whether its author asked for a person. The
  // last is why such a case stands first in its lane; the API's order says so, and the page keeps that order.
  if (row.foundByProgram) marks.push(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue.found);
  if (row.takenByProgram) marks.push(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue.taken);
  // 3d Task 7 [queue.matchFlag]: a match that only flags, which moves nothing.
  if (row.matchFlag) marks.push(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueMatchFlag);
  // 3d Task 8 [queue.flag]: possible coordinated reporting, which moves nothing either.
  if (row.flag !== null) marks.push(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queueFlag);
  if (row.objected) marks.push(AUTOMATION_WORDS.queue.objected);
  return marks;
}

export interface FindingFormState {
  link: string;
  ruleId: RuleId;
  category: TdbCategory;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

export interface QueueViewProps {
  rows: Loadable<QueueRow[]>;
  /** 3e Task 4: the replies no decision answered, oldest first, which lead the queue's first page; never their text. */
  replies?: QueueReply[];
  /** Whether the API named a further page. */
  more: boolean;
  loadingMore: boolean;
  /** The time the ages are counted to. */
  now: number;
  finding: FindingFormState;
  onLoadMore(): void;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  onFindingChange(change: Partial<Pick<FindingFormState, "link" | "ruleId" | "category">>): void;
  onFindingSubmit(): void;
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.5): one reply in "Replies to answer": how long it has waited; before the start (the
 * suspension is held) or after it, until or since its end; the measure; and whether it has waited longer than korbat's
 * aim. The reply's text is read on the case page, where the access log and the recusal apply.
 */
export function replyWords(reply: QueueReply, now: number): string[] {
  const where = reply.onTime
    ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.before
    : reply.endsAt !== null && Date.parse(reply.endsAt) <= now
      ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterEnded(dateTime(reply.endsAt))
      : // A termination has no end: its row names none (3e's review, people9).
        reply.kind === "terminate" || reply.endsAt === null
        ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterTermination
        : STANDING_WORDS.reply.after(dateTime(reply.endsAt));
  const what = reply.kind === "terminate" ? STANDING_WORDS.reply.termination : STANDING_WORDS.reply.suspension(reply.days ?? 1);
  const late = now - Date.parse(reply.filedAt) > REPLY_AIM_HOURS * 60 * 60 * 1000 ? [STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim] : [];
  return [where, what, ...late];
}

function Replies({ replies, now, onOpenCase }: { replies: QueueReply[]; now: number; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {
  return (
    <>
      <h3 id="replies-title">{STANDING_WORDS.reply.title}</h3>
      {replies.length === 0 ? (
        <p>{STANDING_WORDS.reply.none}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="plain replies" aria-labelledby="replies-title">
          {replies.map((reply) => {
            const id = parseCaseId(reply.caseId);
            return (
              <li key={`${reply.decisionId} ${reply.filedAt}`}>
                <time dateTime={reply.filedAt} title={dateTime(reply.filedAt)}>
                  {waited(reply.filedAt, now)}
                </time>
                {`: ${replyWords(reply, now).join("; ")}. `}
                {id ? (
                  <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                    Open the case
                  </CaseLink>
                ) : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

export function QueueView({ rows, replies = [], more, loadingMore, now, finding, onLoadMore, onOpenCase, onFindingChange, onFindingSubmit }: QueueViewProps) {
  const submit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    onFindingSubmit();
  };
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="queue-title">
      <h2 id="queue-title">Queue</h2>
      {/* 3e Task 4: the replies to answer come first. */}
      <Replies replies={replies} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} />
      <p className="hint">Open cases by lane, then by how long their oldest unanswered item has waited. Nothing else orders them.</p>
      <Loaded
        value={rows}
        render={(list) =>
          list.length === 0 ? (
            <p>No case is open.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="scroll">
              <table className="queue">
                <caption className="visually-hidden">Open cases</caption>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col">Lane</th>
                    <th scope="col">Waiting</th>
                    <th scope="col">About</th>
                    <th scope="col">Cites</th>
                    <th scope="col">Marks</th>
                    <th scope="col">
                      <span className="visually-hidden">Open</span>
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {list.map((row) => {
                    const id = parseCaseId(row.id);
                    return (
                      <tr key={row.id}>
                        <td>{LANE_NAMES[row.lane]}</td>
                        <td>
                          <time dateTime={row.oldestOpenAt} title={dateTime(row.oldestOpenAt)}>
                            {waited(row.oldestOpenAt, now)}
                          </time>
                          {`, ${counted(row.openItems, "item", "items")}`}
                        </td>
                        <td>{row.targetType === "post" ? "a post" : "an account"}</td>
                        <td>{[...row.rules, ...row.categories.map(categoryLabel)].join(", ")}</td>
                        <td>{marksOf(row).join(", ")}</td>
                        <td>
                          {id ? (
                            <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                              Open the case
                            </CaseLink>
                          ) : null}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )
        }
      />
      {more ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={onLoadMore} disabled={loadingMore} aria-busy={loadingMore}>
          Load more
        </button>
      ) : null}

      <h3 id="finding-title">Open a case</h3>
      <p className="hint">
        On your own finding: give the korbat link of a post or a profile, the rule it breaks and the category. What you write about it is saved as a text on the case. A finding citing R2 freezes
        the images its case reaches until an admin answers.
      </p>
      <form className="panel" onSubmit={submit} aria-labelledby="finding-title">
        <label htmlFor="finding-link">Link on korbat</label>
        <input id="finding-link" type="text" value={finding.link} maxLength={300} autoComplete="off" spellCheck={false} onChange={(event) => onFindingChange({ link: event.target.value })} />
        <label htmlFor="finding-rule">Rule</label>
        <select id="finding-rule" value={finding.ruleId} onChange={(event) => onFindingChange({ ruleId: event.target.value as RuleId })}>
          {/* Each rule with its title, as the rulebook in force words it. */}
          {RULE_IDS.map((rule) => (
            <option key={rule} value={rule}>
              {`${rule}: ${getRule(rule)?.title ?? ""}`}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <label htmlFor="finding-category">Category</label>
        <select id="finding-category" value={finding.category} onChange={(event) => onFindingChange({ category: event.target.value as TdbCategory })}>
          {FINDING_CATEGORIES.map((category) => (
            <option key={category} value={category}>
              {categoryLabel(category)}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        {finding.error ? (
          <p role="alert" className="error">
            {finding.error}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="submit" className="primary" disabled={finding.busy} aria-busy={finding.busy}>
            Open a case
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}

/** The finding a form's values make, or null when the link is no web address of at most 300 characters: the contracts' schema decides. */
export function findingOf(form: Pick<FindingFormState, "link" | "ruleId" | "category">): FindingRequest | null {
  const parsed = FindingRequest.safeParse({ target: { kind: "link", url: form.link.trim() }, ground: "rule", ruleId: form.ruleId, category: form.category });
  return parsed.success ? parsed.data : null;
}

/**
 * Reads the queue from its start through as many pages as the screen shows, one after the other. `activity` says whether
 * a person's action started the read: the screen's opening and "Load more" do, its own refresh every minute does not.
 */
export async function readQueue(api: StaffApi, pages: number, activity: boolean): Promise<{ rows: QueueRow[]; next: string | null; replies: QueueReply[] }> {
  const rows: QueueRow[] = [];
  const replies: QueueReply[] = [];
  let cursor: string | null = null;
  for (let page = 0; page < Math.max(1, pages); page++) {
    const answer = await api.queue(cursor, { activity });
    rows.push(...answer.cases);
    // Only the first page carries the replies.
    replies.push(...answer.replies);
    cursor = answer.nextCursor;
    if (cursor === null) break;
  }
  return { rows, next: cursor, replies };
}

export function Queue({ api, onOpenCase, clock = systemClock }: { api: StaffApi; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void; clock?: Clock }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Loadable<QueueRow[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [replies, setReplies] = useState<QueueReply[]>([]);
  const [next, setNext] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pages, setPages] = useState(1);
  const [loadingMore, setLoadingMore] = useState(false);
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [finding, setFinding] = useState<FindingFormState>({ link: "", ruleId: "R1", category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1, busy: false, error: null });
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const shown = useRef(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    const read = (activity: boolean) =>
      readQueue(api, shown.current, activity).then(
        (answer) => {
          if (!alive.current) return;
          setRows({ state: "ready", value: answer.rows });
          setReplies(answer.replies);
          setNext(answer.next);
          setNow(Date.now());
        },
        // A refresh that fails leaves the list as it was; only the first read shows its failure.
        (err: unknown) => alive.current && activity && setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
      );
    const stop = startQueueReads(clock, (activity) => void read(activity));
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
      stop();
    };
    // Read from the opening of the screen on; neither the API client nor the clock changes while the page lives.
  }, [api, clock]);

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (next === null || rows.state !== "ready") return;
    setLoadingMore(true);
    try {
      const answer = await api.queue(next, { activity: true });
      if (!alive.current) return;
      shown.current = pages + 1;
      setPages(pages + 1);
      setRows({ state: "ready", value: [...rows.value, ...answer.cases] });
      setNext(answer.nextCursor);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setRows({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoadingMore(false);
    }
  };

  const openFinding = async () => {
    const request = findingOf(finding);
    if (request === null) {
      setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, error: FINDING_WORDS.invalid_request }));
      return;
    }
    setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, busy: true, error: null }));
    try {
      const answer = await api.openFinding(request, { activity: true });
      const id = parseCaseId(answer.caseId);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, busy: false, link: "" }));
      if (id) onOpenCase(id);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, busy: false, error: describeError(err, FINDING_WORDS) }));
    }
  };

  return (
    <QueueView
      rows={rows}
      replies={replies}
      more={next !== null}
      loadingMore={loadingMore}
      now={now}
      finding={finding}
      onLoadMore={() => void loadMore()}
      onOpenCase={onOpenCase}
      // Choosing a rule presets its category; the moderator may still choose another.
      onFindingChange={(change) => setFinding((form) => ({ ...form, ...change, ...(change.ruleId ? { category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY[change.ruleId] } : {}), error: null }))}
      onFindingSubmit={() => void openFinding()}
    />
  );
}
```

```ts
import type { Logger } from "pino";
import { STANDING_RULES, type Platform } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { AccountExport } from "../../auth";
import type { ModerationExport } from "../../moderation";
import type { ProfileExport } from "../../social";
import { AccountError, type AccountDeps } from "../context";
import type { OpenFile, ZipWriter } from "../zip";

/** One export a day (1b design, section 10). */
export const EXPORTS_PER_WINDOW = 1;
export const EXPORT_WINDOW_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

const exportLimitKey = (userId: string) => `export:${userId}`;

/** The entry an image has in the archive; export.json names it under the post's media. */
export function mediaEntry(id: string): string {
  return `media/${id}.webp`;
}

/** The download's name: the handle and the day, so several exports of one account sort by date. */
export function exportFilename(handle: string, now: Date): string {
  return `korbat-export-${handle}-${now.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.zip`;
}

/**
 * What the archive is written from. The account's own facts, the profile and the moderation member are
 * read before the first byte; the profile's lists are read page by page while export.json is written,
 * and the images, each behind the media module's checked open, go first, so `missingMedia` is complete
 * by the time the JSON that lists it is written.
 */
export interface ExportPlan {
  exportedAt: Date;
  /** The handle of the session that asked for the export: the id the auth module lists each session under. */
  currentSession: string;
  account: AccountExport;
  profile: ProfileExport;
  /** The decisions about the account that it was told of and its own reports, as the moderation module hands them over (3c design, section 7.11). */
  moderation: ModerationExport;
  images: { id: string; open: OpenFile }[];
  /** The images whose file the checked open refused or could not find, filled while the images are written. */
  missingMedia: string[];
}

/**
 * Counts one export of the account in the daily window and refuses once it is used up. Taken before
 * anything is built or streamed, so a stream that fails midway still counts; Retry-After says when the
 * window resets.
 */
export async function enforceExportLimit(deps: AccountDeps, userId: string): Promise<void> {
  let hit: { count: number; resetMs: number };
  try {
    hit = await deps.limits.hit(exportLimitKey(userId), EXPORT_WINDOW_MS);
  } catch {
    // Fails closed: an export that cannot be counted is not made, and the client is told to retry shortly.
    throw new AccountError("service_unavailable", 503, undefined, 30);
  }
  if (hit.count > EXPORTS_PER_WINDOW) throw new AccountError("rate_limited", 429, undefined, Math.max(1, Math.ceil(hit.resetMs / 1000)));
}

/**
 * Gives the day's export back after a failure before the archive's first byte (a pool timeout, a
 * restart): the owner received nothing, so the attempt must not use up the day. Best effort: when the
 * store cannot be reached, the export stays counted and a warning says so, which costs the owner a day
 * at worst.
 */
export async function giveBackExport(deps: AccountDeps, userId: string, log: Logger): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await deps.limits.release(exportLimitKey(userId));
  } catch (err) {
    log.warn({ err, userId }, "account export: the day's export could not be given back after a failure before the first byte");
  }
}

const iso = (at: Date): string => at.toISOString();
const isoOrNull = (at: Date | null): string | null => (at ? at.toISOString() : null);

/**
 * What an account module built without the moderation module writes: the member is part of the format, so it is always
 * there. Its reporting counts are empty over the standing rules' frame, the number the moderation module would read.
 */
const NO_MODERATION: ModerationExport = {
  decisions: [],
  reports: [],
  strikes: [],
  standing: [],
  replies: [],
  reporting: { frameDays: STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays, days: [], marks: [], markedReports: 0 },
  uploads: [],
  releases: [],
};

/**
 * Reads what is needed before the first byte: the account's facts, sessions, devices and events (one
 * read, bounded by the 90 days of events), the profile's own fields, the list of images, and the
 * moderation member (the decisions the account was told of and its own reports, both short lists). The
 * four modules are asked at once, so a read that fails costs the owner nothing: no byte was sent yet.
 * `currentSession` is the handle of the session asking, which marks its entry among the sessions.
 * `pageSize` is how many rows of each profile list are read at a time; tests lower it.
 */
export async function buildExport(deps: AccountDeps, userId: string, currentSession: string, now: Date, pageSize?: number): Promise<ExportPlan> {
  const [account, profile, images, moderation] = await Promise.all([
    deps.auth.exportAccount(userId),
    deps.social.exportProfile(userId, pageSize),
    deps.media.exportImages(userId),
    // The server always hands the moderation module over; a test of the other members may leave it out.
    deps.moderation ? deps.moderation.exportFor(userId) : NO_MODERATION,
  ]);
  return { exportedAt: now, currentSession, account, profile, moderation, images, missingMedia: [] };
}

/** A list member of export.json, read in pages and written one element at a time. */
class Paged<T> {
  constructor(
    readonly pages: AsyncIterable<readonly T[]>,
    readonly element: (row: T) => unknown,
  ) {}
}

/** An array already in memory, as one page. */
function inMemory<T>(rows: readonly T[], element: (row: T) => unknown): Paged<T> {
  return new Paged(
    (async function* () {
      yield rows;
    })(),
    element,
  );
}

/** Fragments are gathered into pieces of about this many UTF-16 units, at most 3 bytes each in UTF-8: well under 64 KiB. */
const PIECE_CHARS = 16 * 1024;

/**
 * export.json in pieces, written exactly as JSON.stringify(document, null, 2) writes the whole
 * document: member by member at the top level, and the lists element by element, each element
 * stringified on its own and indented to its depth (JSON.stringify's output holds line breaks only
 * between tokens; one inside a string is escaped, so indenting after every line break is exact). No list
 * is ever whole in memory: each is read page by page as it is written.
 */
export async function* exportJson(plan: ExportPlan): AsyncGenerator<string> {
  let buffer = "";
  for await (const fragment of documentFragments(plan)) {
    buffer += fragment;
    if (buffer.length >= PIECE_CHARS) {
      yield buffer;
      buffer = "";
    }
  }
  if (buffer.length > 0) yield buffer;
}

async function* documentFragments(plan: ExportPlan): AsyncGenerator<string> {

  const other = (row: { handle: string; since: Date }) => ({ handle: row.handle, since: iso(row.since) });
  // The members in the order of the format (ExportFormat in the contracts); the order is part of the bytes.
  const members: [string, unknown][] = [
    ["format", "korbat-export-1"],

      "account",

        email: account.account.email,

        passkeys: account.passkeys.map((passkey) => ({ name: passkey.name, createdAt: iso(passkey.createdAt), lastUsedAt: isoOrNull(passkey.lastUsedAt), synced: passkey.synced, createdOn: passkey.createdOn })),

        showInExplore: profile.profile.showInExplore,

    ["mutes", new Paged(profile.mutes, other)],
    [

/** The moderation member with every entry's members in the order of the format (ExportFormat in the contracts). */
function moderationMember(moderation: ModerationExport): ModerationExport {

      id: decision.id,
      decidedOn: decision.decidedOn,
      postId: decision.postId,
      kind: decision.kind,
      outcome: decision.outcome,
      ground: decision.ground,
      ruleId: decision.ruleId,
      rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
      measures: decision.measures.map((measure) => ({ kind: measure.kind, mediaId: measure.mediaId, noEffect: measure.noEffect })),
      reversals: decision.reversals.map((reversal) => ({ kind: reversal.kind, mediaId: reversal.mediaId })),
      facts: decision.facts,

      legalReference: decision.legalReference,

      // 3d (W.10): what the statement says of automated means, and the objection to a program's measure with its time.
      automatedDetection: decision.automatedDetection,
      automatedDecision: decision.automatedDecision,
      signal: decision.signal === null ? null : { kind: decision.signal.kind, source: decision.signal.source, matchKind: decision.signal.matchKind, listedAs: decision.signal.listedAs, viewed: decision.signal.viewed },
      objection: decision.objection === null ? null : { text: decision.objection.text, createdAt: decision.objection.createdAt },
    })),
    reports: moderation.reports.map((report) => ({

      receivedAt: report.receivedAt,
      ground: report.ground,
      ruleId: report.ruleId,
      category: report.category,
      explanation: report.explanation,
      items: report.items.map((item) => ({ position: item.position, link: item.link, reexamines: item.reexamines, outcome: item.outcome, outcomeText: item.outcomeText, reexaminationOpen: item.reexaminationOpen })),
    })),
    // 3e (W.8): the strikes the account was given.
    strikes: moderation.strikes.map((strike) => ({ decisionId: strike.decisionId, postId: strike.postId, ruleId: strike.ruleId, givenAt: strike.givenAt, countsUntil: strike.countsUntil, overruledAt: strike.overruledAt })),
    // Then its suspensions, terminations and reporting measures, its replies to them, and its own reporting counts.
    standing: moderation.standing.map((entry) => ({
      decisionId: entry.decisionId,
      kind: entry.kind,
      basis: entry.basis,
      days: entry.days,
      announced: entry.announced,
      decidedAt: entry.decidedAt,
      earliestStart: entry.earliestStart,
      startsAt: entry.startsAt,
      endsAt: entry.endsAt,
      liftedAt: entry.liftedAt,
      liftedBy: entry.liftedBy,
      replaced: entry.replaced,
      basisEndedAt: entry.basisEndedAt,
      basisEndedBy: entry.basisEndedBy,
    })),
    replies: moderation.replies.map((reply) => ({ decisionId: reply.decisionId, filedAt: reply.filedAt, onTime: reply.onTime, text: reply.text, erasedAt: reply.erasedAt, answeredAt: reply.answeredAt, answeredBy: reply.answeredBy })),
    reporting: {
      frameDays: moderation.reporting.frameDays,
      days: moderation.reporting.days.map((entry) => ({ day: entry.day, reports: entry.reports })),
      marks: moderation.reporting.marks.map((mark) => ({ ref: mark.ref, position: mark.position, sentOn: mark.sentOn, markedAt: mark.markedAt, withdrawnAt: mark.withdrawnAt, counts: mark.counts })),
      markedReports: moderation.reporting.markedReports,
    },
    // 3d (W.10): the refused uploads as their notices read them, and the releases the account may be told of.
    uploads: moderation.uploads.map((upload) => ({
      id: upload.id,
      refusedAt: upload.refusedAt,
      source: upload.source,
      matchKind: upload.matchKind,
      listedAs: upload.listedAs,
      objection: upload.objection === null ? null : { text: upload.objection.text, objectedAt: upload.objection.objectedAt },
      mayObject: upload.mayObject,
      endedAt: upload.endedAt,
      endAs: upload.endAs,
      endReason: upload.endReason,
      released: upload.released,
      reportKept: upload.reportKept,

  };
}

/** A top-level member's array, as JSON.stringify writes it at that depth: "[]" when empty, else one element per line group. */
async function* listFragments<T>(list: Paged<T>): AsyncGenerator<string> {
  let first = true;
  for await (const page of list.pages) {
    for (const row of page) {
      yield `${first ? "[\n" : ",\n"}    ${indented(JSON.stringify(list.element(row), null, 2), "    ")}`;
      first = false;
    }
  }
  yield first ? "[]" : "\n  ]";
}

const indented = (json: string, pad: string): string => json.replaceAll("\n", `\n${pad}`);

/**
 * Writes the archive: every image as a stored entry, then export.json, then the central directory.
 * export.json comes last so that missingMedia can name every image whose file the checked open refused
 * or did not find when its turn came (the sweeper may be between the row and the file), or that was no
 * longer the owner's to export by then: the media module reads each image's row again as it opens the
 * file, and opens none for an image deleted with its post, erased or sealed since the list was read.
 * The order of entries means nothing to a reader.
 */
export async function writeExport(writer: ZipWriter, plan: ExportPlan): Promise<void> {
  for (const image of plan.images) {
    if (!(await writer.addFile(mediaEntry(image.id), image.open))) plan.missingMedia.push(image.id);
  }
  await writer.addJsonPieces("export.json", exportJson(plan));
  await writer.end();
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The staff command line's recovery (3f design, sections 6.6, 7.16, 7.17 and 8.11, "Recovery and the counts"):
 *
 *   docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm api node dist/staff.js audit-export [--after <place>] > file.jsonl
 *   cat <files> | docker compose -f infra/compose.yml run --rm -T migrate node dist/staff.js restore-import [<place>:<hash> ...]
 *
 * audit-export is the keeper's download from the server: the rows after a place as JSON lines on standard output, in the
 * console's form (AuditExportLine), and its own copy mark with the audit row copy_marked under the system actor, since its
 * output goes to a file on the server and no browser has to confirm it. It runs on the API's role, as audit-head does.
 *
 * restore-import runs after a restore, as the migrator, in one transaction, with the keeper's files concatenated on
 * standard input, oldest first: every file from the one that holds the restored head's place onward. It checks every
 * line with the chain's canonical text in this program's own code (staff/chain.ts) and nothing of the database's; the
 * lines at or below the restored head are checked and not imported, and the run above it must continue the head. A
 * changed line refuses everything (tail_not_continuous); a hole is reported, and the unbroken run from the head is
 * imported. It writes again the plain records the lost rows describe, with their original times and an imported mark,
 * and one row of restore_gaps for every lost decision and every lost record it can only note; never a decision or a
 * measure: a person takes each lost measure again, under a key, from the console's After a restore screen.
 *
 * This file has no entry point of its own, so both bundles can include it (build.mjs says why that matters).
 */
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { AuditExportLine, GAP_CLASSES, GAP_SITE_CLASSES, MEASURES, type ActionKind, type GapClass } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../auth";
import { insertOrder, postLink, type NewOrderItem } from "../moderation";
import { CHAIN_ZERO_HASH, appendAuditRow, canonicalText, chainHash, exportLines } from "../staff";
import { Refusal, isoOf, refuse, rows } from "./orders";

/** The recovery commands, each with its first line of STAFF_USAGE. */
export const RESTORE_COMMANDS = ["audit-export", "restore-import"] as const;
export type RestoreCommandName = (typeof RESTORE_COMMANDS)[number];

export const RESTORE_USAGE = [
  "  audit-export [--after <place>]         print the audit log's rows after the place (after the command line's own last copy",
  "                                         when left out) as JSON lines, and record the copy; run it in the api service",
  "  restore-import [<place>:<hash> ...] < files   after a restore: check the keeper's files, oldest first, against the restored",
  "                                         head, write the lost records again and list the gaps; as the migrator, with -T",
];

/** A place as the keeper copies it, as audit-verify takes it: at most 15 digits and a lower-case hex sha256. */
const KEPT_PLACE = /^([1-9][0-9]{0,14}):([0-9a-f]{64})$/;
const PLACE = /^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,14})$/;

export type RestoreCommand = { command: "audit-export"; after: number | null } | { command: "restore-import"; kept: { seq: number; hash: string }[] };

/** Reads a recovery command's words. */
export function parseRestoreArgs(command: RestoreCommandName, rest: readonly string[]): RestoreCommand {
  if (command === "audit-export") {
    if (rest.length === 0) return { command, after: null };
    if (rest.length === 2 && rest[0] === "--after" && PLACE.test(rest[1]!)) return { command, after: Number(rest[1]) };
    throw new Error(`audit-export: takes --after <place>, a place as audit-head prints it`);
  }
  return {
    command,
    kept: rest.map((arg) => {
      const match = KEPT_PLACE.exec(arg);
      if (!match) throw new Error(`restore-import: not a kept place: ${arg} (a kept place is <chain_seq>:<hash>, as audit-head prints it)`);
      return { seq: Number(match[1]), hash: match[2]! };
    }),
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- audit-export

/** What audit-export did: the places it printed and how many rows, or nothing newer. */
export type ExportDone = { from: number; to: number; rows: number } | { from: null; to: null; rows: 0 };

/**
 * audit-export (7.16 step 5, 8.11) on the API's role: the rows after `after` (the command line's own newest copy mark, or
 * 0, when none is given) up to the head as it stands when the command starts, each as one JSON line handed to `write`,
 * oldest first; then, once every line is written, one transaction with the copy mark under the system actor and the
 * audit row copy_marked, last. Nothing newer writes nothing.
 */
export async function auditExport(apiDb: Db, after: number | null, write: (line: string) => Promise<void>): Promise<ExportDone> {
  const [head] = await rows<{ seq: string }>(apiDb, sql`select h.seq::text as seq from public.audit_head h where h.id = 1`);
  const through = Number(head?.seq ?? 0);
  const [own] = await rows<{ place: string }>(apiDb, sql`select m.place::text as place from public.copy_marks m where m.staff_id = ${SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID}::uuid order by m.at desc, m.id desc limit 1`);
  const start = after ?? Number(own?.place ?? 0);
  if (through <= start) return { from: null, to: null, rows: 0 };
  let count = 0;
  for await (const line of exportLines(apiDb, start, through)) {
    await write(JSON.stringify(line));
    count++;
  }
  await apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
    // The API role inserts these two columns alone; the trigger forces the mark's time.
    await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.copy_marks (staff_id, place) values (${SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID}::uuid, ${through}::bigint)`);
    await appendAuditRow(tx, { actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, action: "copy_marked", targetType: null, targetId: null, requestId: null, metadata: { after: start, through, rows: count } });
  });
  return { from: start + 1, to: through, rows: count };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- restore-import: the lines

/** A line of the keeper's files, read, with its line number on standard input and its metadata as parsed. */
interface TailLine {
  n: number;
  line: AuditExportLine;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
}

/** Every line refused for the same sentence: a changed file, never a missing one. */
const refused = (n: number, head: { seq: number; hash: string }): never => {
  throw new Refusal(`restore-import: refused: line ${n} does not continue the restored head ${head.seq}:${head.hash}; nothing was written`);
};

/**
 * Reads the input's lines (blank lines are skipped) and checks each by itself: it is an AuditExportLine, and its hash
 * recomputes from its own members with the canonical text and the line's prevHash. A line that fails either is a changed
 * file, refused whole. A line repeated exactly (two downloads that overlap) is read once; a place read twice with two
 * hashes is a changed file.
 */
export function readTail(input: Buffer, head: { seq: number; hash: string }): TailLine[] {
  const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
  const lines: TailLine[] = [];
  const byPlace = new Map<number, string>();
  const text = input.toString("utf8").split(LF);
  for (const [index, raw] of text.entries()) {
    if (raw.trim() === "") continue;
    const n = index + 1;
    let parsed: AuditExportLine;
    let metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    try {
      parsed = AuditExportLine.parse(JSON.parse(raw));
      metadata = JSON.parse(parsed.metadata) as Record<string, unknown>;
      const recomputed = chainHash(
        parsed.prevHash,
        canonicalText({
          chainVersion: parsed.v,
          chainSeq: parsed.place,
          id: parsed.id,
          createdAt: new Date(parsed.at),
          actorId: parsed.actor,
          action: parsed.action,
          targetType: parsed.targetType,
          targetId: parsed.targetId,
          requestId: parsed.requestId,
          staffSession: parsed.staffSession,
          keyId: parsed.keyId,
          actionHash: parsed.actionHash,
          stepUpText: parsed.stepUp,
          metadataText: parsed.metadata,
        }),
      );
      // A time that does not print back as it was written would hash another text: the line was changed.
      if (recomputed !== parsed.hash || new Date(parsed.at).toISOString() !== parsed.at) return refused(n, head);
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof Refusal) throw err;
      return refused(n, head);
    }
    const seen = byPlace.get(parsed.place);
    if (seen !== undefined) {
      if (seen !== parsed.hash) return refused(n, head);
      continue;
    }
    byPlace.set(parsed.place, parsed.hash);
    lines.push({ n, line: parsed, metadata });
  }
  return lines;
}

/** What the walk found: the lines checked below the head, the run to import, and the hole that ends it, if any. */
export interface Walked {
  checked: number;
  run: TailLine[];
  hole: { after: number; before: number } | null;
}

/**
 * The walk of 7.17 step 2.1 over lines in input order. Every line names the line before it where that line is in the
 * input (a line at the next place with another prevHash, or a line at a place not after the one before, is a changed
 * file); the line at the head's place holds the head's hash; a kept place the input holds holds the hash the keeper
 * noted. Above the head the first line must be the head's next place and name the head's hash (input that begins
 * above that is refused: the lost rows cannot be downloaded again); the run stops at the first line whose place is not
 * the next one, which is the hole the import reports.
 */
export function walkTail(lines: readonly TailLine[], head: { seq: number; hash: string }, kept: readonly { seq: number; hash: string }[]): Walked {
  for (const place of kept) {
    const found = lines.find((entry) => entry.line.place === place.seq);
    if (found !== undefined && found.line.hash !== place.hash) refused(found.n, head);
  }
  let checked = 0;
  const run: TailLine[] = [];
  let hole: Walked["hole"] = null;
  let prev: TailLine | null = null;
  for (const entry of lines) {
    const { line } = entry;
    if (prev !== null) {
      if (line.place <= prev.line.place) refused(entry.n, head);
      if (line.place === prev.line.place + 1 && line.prevHash !== prev.line.hash) refused(entry.n, head);
    }
    if (line.place <= head.seq) {
      if (line.place === head.seq && line.hash !== head.hash) refused(entry.n, head);
      checked++;
    } else if (hole === null) {
      const last = run[run.length - 1];
      if (last === undefined) {
        // The first line above the head continues it, or the input is refused whole.
        if (line.place !== head.seq + 1 || line.prevHash !== (head.seq === 0 ? CHAIN_ZERO_HASH : head.hash)) refused(entry.n, head);
        run.push(entry);
      } else if (line.place === last.line.place + 1) run.push(entry);
      else hole = { after: last.line.place, before: line.place };
    }
    prev = entry;
  }
  return { checked, run, hole };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- restore-import: what a lost row writes again

/** What the import wrote again, for its lines and its audit row. */
interface Counts {
  orders: number;
  items: number;
  events: number;
  notifications: number;
  productions: number;
}

/** One gap as the import wrote it, for the printed list. */
interface WrittenGap {
  class: GapClass;
  place: number;
  targetType: string | null;
  targetId: string | null;
  actedAt: string;
  open: boolean;
}

/** The class of a lost decision (6.6): by the measures its signed actions hold, and for a seal by the decision's kind. */
export function decisionClass(params: { kind?: unknown; actions?: unknown }): GapClass {
  const kinds = Array.isArray(params.actions) ? params.actions.map((action) => (action as { kind?: unknown }).kind).filter((kind): kind is ActionKind => typeof kind === "string" && kind in MEASURES) : [];
  const measures = kinds.filter((kind) => MEASURES[kind].lifts === null);
  if (measures.includes("seal_media")) return params.kind === "interim" ? "seal_interim" : "seal_final";
  if (measures.some((kind) => kind === "suspend" || kind === "terminate")) return "standing";
  if (measures.length > 0) return "restriction";
  if (kinds.length > 0) return "reversal";
  return "no_measure";
}

/** The columns a correction of an order's record changes, by the member names its audit row carries. */
const CORRECTED_COLUMNS: Record<string, string> = {
  kind: "kind",
  memberState: "member_state",
  authority: "authority",
  reference: "reference",
  channel: "channel",
  sectionC: "section_c",
  emergency: "emergency",
  withholdFromAuthor: "withhold_from_author",
  crossBorder: "cross_border",
};

/** The writer of one import, in its transaction: the gaps it writes and what it wrote again. */
class Importer {
  readonly counts: Counts = { orders: 0, items: 0, events: 0, notifications: 0, productions: 0 };
  readonly gaps: WrittenGap[] = [];
  /**
   * 3d Task 8 (7.3, W.11): the published versions of the yearly edition that the restored database no longer holds, each
   * by its year, version and the time it was published. The import writes nothing for them and opens no gap: the job
   * publishes a due version again, and the operator reads Restoring for what a reader of /transparency then sees.
   */
  readonly editionsLost: { year: number; version: number; at: string }[] = [];
  constructor(
    private readonly tx: DbTx,
    private readonly importId: string,
    private readonly appOrigin: string | null,
  ) {}

  /** One gap of the lost row: open for a decision or a record it could only note, closed as imported for one it wrote again. */
  async gap(entry: TailLine, cls: GapClass, open: boolean, target: { type: string | null; id: string | null } = { type: entry.line.targetType, id: entry.line.targetId }): Promise<void> {
    const { line } = entry;
    await this.tx.execute(sql`
      insert into public.restore_gaps (import_id, place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, acted_at, imported_at, class, closed_at, disposition)
      values (${this.importId}::uuid, ${line.place}::bigint, ${line.hash}, ${line.action}, ${target.type}, ${target.id}, ${line.metadata}::jsonb,
              ${line.at}::timestamptz, now(), ${cls}, ${open ? null : sql`now()`}, ${open ? null : "imported"})`);
    this.gaps.push({ class: cls, place: line.place, targetType: target.type, targetId: target.id, actedAt: line.at, open });
  }

  /** A staff account by its id when the restored database holds its profile, else null: a profile is a foreign key. */
  private async staff(id: string): Promise<string | null> {
    if (id === SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID) return null;
    const [row] = await rows<{ id: string }>(this.tx, sql`select p.id from public.profiles p where p.id = ${id}::uuid`);
    return row?.id ?? null;
  }

  /** Whether the order is there; and, since a lost row of it is written again, its imported_at, which exempts its old events (0031). */
  private async touch(orderId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    const touched = await rows<{ id: string }>(this.tx, sql`update public.legal_orders set imported_at = coalesce(imported_at, now()) where id = ${orderId}::uuid returning id`);
    return touched.length > 0;
  }

  /** An item's link as the import writes it: the post's address when the lost row named a post, else the link's digest (6.6). */
  private link(item: Record<string, unknown>): NewOrderItem {
    if (typeof item.postId === "string") {
      if (this.appOrigin === null) refuse("restore-import", "APP_ORIGIN must be set for the migrate service, to write an imported item's address");
      return { link: postLink(this.appOrigin!, item.postId), postId: item.postId };
    }
    return { link: `sha256:${String(item.linkSha256)}`, postId: null };
  }

  /** order_opened: the order, its items and its event `opened`, with their original times, through insertOrder; and the event `imported`. */
  async orderOpened(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    const [exists] = await rows<{ id: string }>(this.tx, sql`select id from public.legal_orders where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
    if (exists === undefined) {
      const items = (m.items as Record<string, unknown>[]) ?? [];
      const messageId = typeof m.messageId === "string" ? ((await rows<{ id: string }>(this.tx, sql`select id from public.contact_messages where id = ${m.messageId}::uuid`))[0]?.id ?? null) : null;
      await insertOrder(this.tx, {
        id: orderId,
        kind: m.kind as never,
        memberState: String(m.memberState),
        authority: String(m.authority),
        reference: String(m.reference),
        channel: m.channel as never,
        messageId,
        sectionC: m.sectionC === true,
        emergency: m.emergency === true,
        crossBorder: m.crossBorder === true,
        withholdFromAuthor: m.withholdFromAuthor === true,
        openedBy: await this.staff(entry.line.actor),
        items: items.map((item) => this.link(item)),
        imported: {
          openedAt: new Date(String(m.openedAt)),
          openedVia: m.via === "cli" ? "cli" : "console",
          receivedAt: typeof m.receivedAt === "string" ? new Date(m.receivedAt) : null,
          sentAt: typeof m.sentAt === "string" ? new Date(m.sentAt) : null,
          items: items.map((item) => ({ id: String(item.itemId), position: Number(item.position), addedAt: new Date(String(item.addedAt)) })),
        },
      });
      await this.tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, at, via) values (${orderId}::uuid, 'imported', now(), 'cli')`);
      this.counts.orders++;
      this.counts.items += items.length;
      this.counts.events += 2;
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /** order_items_added: the items, with their own ids, positions and times. */
  async itemsAdded(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    if (await this.touch(orderId)) {
      for (const item of (entry.metadata.items as Record<string, unknown>[]) ?? []) {
        const { link, postId } = this.link(item);
        await this.tx.execute(sql`
          insert into public.legal_order_items (id, order_id, position, link, post_id, added_at)
          values (${String(item.itemId)}::uuid, ${orderId}::uuid, ${Number(item.position)}::smallint, ${link}, ${postId}::uuid, ${String(item.addedAt)}::timestamptz)
          on conflict do nothing`);
        this.counts.items++;
      }
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /**
   * order_corrected: the changed members' new values in one update (the CHECKs hold at each row update, as order_correct
   * writes them), with the withholding and the preservation the order's kind forces; the items it closed; its event.
   */
  async corrected(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    if (await this.touch(orderId)) {
      const changed = (m.changed as Record<string, unknown>[]) ?? [];
      const to = (member: string) => changed.find((change) => change.member === member)?.to ?? null;
      // The withholding and the preservation are written in the same statement, from the new values: the CHECK on a
      // removal order holds at each row update, and a column may be set once in one statement.
      const sets = changed
        .filter((change) => typeof change.member === "string" && change.member in CORRECTED_COLUMNS && change.member !== "withholdFromAuthor")
        .map((change) => sql`${sql.raw(CORRECTED_COLUMNS[change.member as string]!)} = ${change.to as string | boolean}`);
      const kind = sql`coalesce(${to("kind") as string | null}::text, kind)`;
      await this.tx.execute(sql`
        update public.legal_orders
           set ${sets.length > 0 ? sql`${sql.join(sets, sql`, `)}, ` : sql``}
               withhold_from_author = coalesce(${to("withholdFromAuthor") as boolean | null}::boolean, withhold_from_author) or ${kind} = 'tco_removal'
                                      or coalesce(${to("sectionC") as boolean | null}::boolean, section_c),
               preserve = ${kind} = 'tco_removal'
         where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      for (const change of changed.filter((entry) => entry.member === "closeItems")) {
        await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set closed_at = ${entry.line.at}::timestamptz, closed_reason = ${String(change.reason)}
                                   where id = ${String(change.itemId)}::uuid and order_id = ${orderId}::uuid and disabled_at is null`);
      }
      await this.event(orderId, { id: typeof m.eventId === "string" ? m.eventId : null, kind: "corrected", ground: String(m.rule), at: entry.line.at, by: await this.staff(entry.line.actor), via: "console" });
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /** order_event_recorded: the console's event, and what it set on the order (a closing, a reopening, the extension). */
  async consoleEvent(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    const params = (m.params as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    if (await this.touch(orderId)) {
      const kind = String(params.kind);
      if (kind === "closed_without_effect") await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = ${entry.line.at}::timestamptz where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      if (kind === "reopened") await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = null where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      if (kind === "hold_extended") await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set hold_extended = true where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      await this.event(orderId, {
        id: typeof m.eventId === "string" ? m.eventId : null,
        kind,
        ground: typeof params.ground === "string" ? params.ground : null,
        at: entry.line.at,
        effectiveAt: typeof m.effectiveAt === "string" ? m.effectiveAt : null,
        by: await this.staff(entry.line.actor),
        via: "console",
      });
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /** One event of an order with its original time, as the migrator, whose insert the trigger does not force. */
  private async event(orderId: string, e: { id: string | null; kind: string; ground: string | null; at: string; effectiveAt?: string | null; by: string | null; via: string; itemId?: string | null }): Promise<void> {
    await this.tx.execute(sql`
      insert into public.legal_order_events (id, order_id, item_id, kind, at, effective_at, ground, by_staff, via)
      values (coalesce(${e.id}::uuid, gen_random_uuid()), ${orderId}::uuid, ${e.itemId ?? null}::uuid, ${e.kind}, ${e.at}::timestamptz, ${e.effectiveAt ?? null}::timestamptz,
              ${e.ground}, ${e.by}::uuid, ${e.via})
      on conflict do nothing`);
    this.counts.events++;
  }

  /**
   * order_recorded: a command line's event, with what the command set on the order, from the facts its audit row holds.
   * A text the command recorded (the reasons, the remedies, the scope, how a check was made, a hold's basis) is named
   * there by its digest alone and stays lost: its event is written, its column is not.
   */
  async cliEvent(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    const orderId = entry.line.targetId!;
    const at = entry.line.at;
    if (await this.touch(orderId)) {
      const set = (assignments: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set ${assignments} where id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
      const time = (value: unknown) => (typeof value === "string" ? value : null);
      const event = String(m.event);
      let ground: string | null = null;
      let effectiveAt: string | null = null;
      let itemId: string | null = null;
      switch (event) {
        case "received_set":
          await set(sql`received_at = ${time(m.receivedAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "sent_at_set":
          await set(sql`sent_at = ${time(m.sentAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "due_set":
          await set(sql`due_at = ${time(m.dueAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "verified":
          await set(sql`verified_at = ${time(m.verifiedAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "issued_at_set":
          await set(sql`issued_at = ${time(m.issuedAt)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "document_recorded":
          await set(sql`document_sha256 = ${String(m.documentSha256)}, document_bytes = ${Number(m.documentBytes)}::bigint`);
          break;
        case "reopened":
          await set(sql`closed_at = null`);
          break;
        case "tell_person_set":
          await set(sql`tell_person = ${String(m.rule)}, tell_person_at = ${time(m.at)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "hold_until_set":
          await set(sql`authority_hold_until = ${time(m.until)}::timestamptz`);
          break;
        case "hold_extended":
          await set(sql`hold_extended = true`);
          effectiveAt = time(m.received);
          break;
        case "hold_ended":
          ground = String(m.reason);
          await set(sql`hold_ended_at = ${at}::timestamptz, hold_end_reason = ${ground}`);
          break;
        case "scrutiny_requested":
          effectiveAt = time(m.at);
          break;
        case "scrutiny_decided":
          ground = String(m.outcome);
          effectiveAt = time(m.at);
          break;
        case "person_told":
          effectiveAt = time(m.at);
          break;
        case "preservation_extended":
          itemId = String(m.itemId);
          await this.tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set preserve_until = ${time(m.until)}::timestamptz where id = ${itemId}::uuid and order_id = ${orderId}::uuid`);
          break;
      }
      await this.event(orderId, { id: null, kind: event, ground, at, effectiveAt, by: null, via: "cli", itemId });
    }
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /**
   * order_effected: one gap of the class order_effect an item, and each item's first disabling and preservation as the
   * lost row dates them (LAB F): an item whose preservation never ended keeps preserve_until, so its post is frozen at once,
   * before any measure is back, and the disabling taken again starts no new period. No decision, no measure.
   */
  async effected(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const decisionIds = (entry.metadata.decisionIds as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
    for (const itemId of Object.keys(decisionIds).sort()) {
      await this.tx.execute(sql`
        update public.legal_order_items i
           set disabled_at = coalesce(i.disabled_at, ${entry.line.at}::timestamptz),
               preserve_until = case when o.preserve and i.preserve_ended_at is null then coalesce(i.preserve_until, public.order_preserve_until(${entry.line.at}::timestamptz)) else i.preserve_until end
          from public.legal_orders o
         where o.id = i.order_id and i.id = ${itemId}::uuid and i.action_id is null`);
      await this.gap(entry, "order_effect", true, { type: "order_item", id: itemId });
    }
  }

  /** case_decided and appeals_reviewed: one open gap, of the class the lost decision's signed actions give it. */
  async decided(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    await this.gap(entry, decisionClass((entry.metadata.params as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {}), true);
  }

  /**
   * notification_recorded: the step `opened` writes the record again, owed, with its original opening and imported_at,
   * its case, its seal and its duties, and its account as the restored case names it; every later step (sent, declined,
   * answered, event), whose row holds too little to write it (an authority, a channel, a reason), is a gap of the class
   * record, which the operator closes by entering it again with its command and --gap.
   */
  async notification(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const m = entry.metadata;
    if (m.step !== "opened") return this.gap(entry, "record", true);
    const caseId = typeof m.caseId === "string" ? m.caseId : null;
    const seal = typeof m.sealActionId === "string" ? m.sealActionId : null;
    const duties = Array.isArray(m.duties) ? (m.duties as string[]) : [];
    const written = await rows<{ id: string }>(
      this.tx,
      sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (id, state, duties, case_id, seal_action_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via, imported_at)
          select ${entry.line.targetId}::uuid, 'owed', ${`{${duties.join(",")}}`}::text[], ${caseId}::uuid, ${seal}::uuid,
                 (select case when k.target_type = 'account' then k.target_id else (select p.author_id from public.posts p where p.id = k.target_id) end
                    from public.cases k where k.id = ${caseId}::uuid),
                 ${typeof m.at === "string" ? m.at : entry.line.at}::timestamptz, ${seal === null ? "cli" : "system"}, now()
          on conflict do nothing
          returning id`,
    );
    this.counts.notifications += written.length;
    await this.gap(entry, "record", false);
  }

  /** A production, or an access for an authority, which the import can only note: a gap of the class record. */
  async noted(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    await this.gap(entry, "record", true);
  }

  /**
   * 3d Task 2 (design, sections 6.2 and 7.3 step 1): a lost release of a seal is a gap of the class release, which
   * staff.js release-replay closes: the restored database again treats its images as sealed and kept.
   */
  async released(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    await this.gap(entry, "release", true);
  }

  /**
   * A lost leave (release_leave_recorded): a gap of the class release, which release-leave --gap closes when the operator
   * records it again, under the id its line names; none for a leave that a later line of the copy withdraws (it supported
   * no release), and none where the restored database holds the leave as the line records it (nothing was lost). A line
   * that ended an open hold on telling of a leave the database holds is a gap that release-leave --end-untold --gap closes.
   */
  async leaveRecorded(entry: TailLine, withdrawnLater: ReadonlySet<string>): Promise<void> {
    const leaveId = entry.metadata.leaveId;
    if (typeof leaveId !== "string" || withdrawnLater.has(leaveId)) return;
    const [held] = await rows<{ until: string | null }>(this.tx, sql`select ${isoOf("l.untold_until")} as until from public.release_leaves l where l.id = ${leaveId}::uuid`);
    if (held !== undefined && held.until === (entry.metadata.untoldUntil ?? null)) return;
    await this.gap(entry, "release", true);
  }

  /**
   * 3d Task 8: a lost edition_published row (the system's, 6.4). A cheap check and no write: whether the restored database
   * holds that version of that year's edition. One it lacks is listed for the operator, never published again here.
   */
  async edition(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const year = Number(entry.metadata.year);
    const version = Number(entry.metadata.version);
    if (!Number.isInteger(year) || !Number.isInteger(version)) return;
    const [held] = await rows<{ year: number }>(this.tx, sql`select e.year from public.transparency_editions e where e.year = ${year}::smallint and e.version = ${version}::smallint`);
    if (held === undefined) this.editionsLost.push({ year, version, at: entry.line.at });
  }

  /**
   * A lost withdrawal of a leave (release_leave_withdrawn): a gap of the class release only where the restored database
   * holds the leave and shows it standing, which release-leave --withdraw --gap closes; a leave it does not hold supported
   * no release and is not recorded again.
   */
  async leaveWithdrawn(entry: TailLine): Promise<void> {
    const leaveId = entry.metadata.leaveId;
    if (typeof leaveId !== "string") return;
    const [held] = await rows<{ withdrawn: boolean }>(this.tx, sql`select l.withdrawn_at is not null as withdrawn from public.release_leaves l where l.id = ${leaveId}::uuid`);
    if (held === undefined || held.withdrawn) return;
    await this.gap(entry, "release", true);
  }
}

/** Runs one lost row through the importer, by its action; a row that describes neither a record nor a decision writes nothing. */
async function importLine(importer: Importer, entry: TailLine, withdrawnLater: ReadonlySet<string>): Promise<void> {
  switch (entry.line.action) {
    // 3d Task 2: a release of a seal, a leave recorded and a leave withdrawn, each a gap of the class release.
    case "seal_released":
    // 3d Task 7 (7.3 step 1): a held upload's release, and the end of a hold, each a gap of the class release: the first
    // release-replay closes; the second the admin's new end of the hold closes when the restored database holds the
    // refusal (upload_hold_end, reapplied), and release-replay when it does not (upload_hold_replay).
    case "upload_released":
    case "upload_hold_ended":
      return importer.released(entry);
    case "release_leave_recorded":
      return importer.leaveRecorded(entry, withdrawnLater);
    case "release_leave_withdrawn":
      return importer.leaveWithdrawn(entry);
    case "order_opened":
      return importer.orderOpened(entry);
    case "order_items_added":
      return importer.itemsAdded(entry);
    case "order_corrected":
      return importer.corrected(entry);
    case "order_event_recorded":
      return importer.consoleEvent(entry);
    case "order_recorded":
      return importer.cliEvent(entry);
    case "order_effected":
      return importer.effected(entry);
    case "case_decided":
    case "appeals_reviewed":
    // 3d Task 6 (8.7, "A program's lost measure"): a program's decision is lost like a person's, by the class its one
    // measure gives it, a restriction for a withheld image and seal_interim for a seal; a person decides it again.
    case "automated_decided":
      return importer.decided(entry);
    case "notification_recorded":
      return importer.notification(entry);
    case "production_recorded":
      return importer.noted(entry);
    case "preserved_accessed":
      // An access for an authority opened a production of its own (Task 5); an access for a review or a complaint did not.
      if (typeof entry.metadata.productionId === "string") return importer.noted(entry);
      return;
    // 3d Task 8 (W.11): a published version of the yearly edition the backup lacks is listed, and nothing is written.
    case "edition_published":
      return importer.edition(entry);
    default:
      // A sign-in, a key's or a session's row, a retention round, a copy, a message closed, a reveal: no record of 3f and
      // no measure. The mailbox and the operator's notes are their record.
      return;
  }
}

/** What restore-import reports: its lines on standard output, or its one sentence of refusal. */
export type ImportDone = { ok: true; lines: string[] } | { ok: false; problem: string };

/**
 * restore-import (7.17 step 2, 8.11), as the migrator, in one transaction with the 10-second lock timeout: reads the
 * restored head, checks the input (readTail, walkTail), writes again what the unbroken run from the head describes and the
 * gaps, and last the audit row restore_imported under the system actor, with the first and last places, the counts by
 * class, the hole and the SHA-256 of the input as given (the files arrive concatenated, so one digest names them all).
 */
export async function restoreImport(migrateDb: Db, kept: readonly { seq: number; hash: string }[], input: Buffer, appOrigin: string | null): Promise<ImportDone> {
  const c = "restore-import";
  try {
    const lines = await migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      const [row] = await rows<{ seq: string; hash: string }>(tx, sql`select h.seq::text as seq, h.hash from public.audit_head h where h.id = 1`);
      const head = { seq: Number(row!.seq), hash: row!.hash };
      const walked = walkTail(readTail(input, head), head, kept);
      const importer = new Importer(tx, randomUUID(), appOrigin);
      // 3d Task 2: a leave that a later line of the copy withdraws gets no gap: it supported no release.
      const withdrawnLater = new Set(walked.run.filter((entry) => entry.line.action === "release_leave_withdrawn").map((entry) => String(entry.metadata.leaveId)));
      for (const entry of walked.run) await importLine(importer, entry, withdrawnLater);
      const first = walked.run[0]?.line.place ?? null;
      const last = walked.run[walked.run.length - 1]?.line.place ?? null;
      const byClass = Object.fromEntries(GAP_CLASSES.map((cls) => [cls, importer.gaps.filter((gap) => gap.class === cls).length]).filter(([, n]) => (n as number) > 0));
      await appendAuditRow(tx, {
        actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID,
        action: "restore_imported",
        targetType: null,
        targetId: null,
        requestId: null,
        metadata: {
          firstPlace: first,
          lastPlace: last,
          counts: byClass,
          holes: walked.hole === null ? [] : [[walked.hole.after, walked.hole.before]],
          files: [createHash("sha256").update(input).digest("hex")],
        },
      });
      return describeImport(c, head, walked, importer, lastLineAt(input));
    });
    return { ok: true, lines };
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof Refusal) return { ok: false, problem: err.message };
    throw err;
  }
}

/** The time of the input's last line: the keeper's last download, after which nothing is in these files. */
function lastLineAt(input: Buffer): string | null {
  const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
  const text = input.toString("utf8").split(LF).filter((line) => line.trim() !== "");
  try {
    return text.length === 0 ? null : (AuditExportLine.parse(JSON.parse(text[text.length - 1]!)).at as string);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** The lines 8.11 prints after an import: what continued the head, what was written again, the gaps in their order, what to do. */
function describeImport(c: string, head: { seq: number; hash: string }, walked: Walked, importer: Importer, lastAt: string | null): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const first = walked.run[0]?.line.place;
  const last = walked.run[walked.run.length - 1]?.line.place;
  out.push(
    first === undefined
      ? `${c}: the files hold nothing after the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash} (${walked.checked} earlier lines checked, not imported).`
      : `${c}: places ${first} to ${last} continue the head ${head.seq}:${head.hash} (${walked.checked} earlier lines checked, not imported).`,
  );
  const n = importer.counts;
  out.push(`${c}: written again: ${n.orders} orders, ${n.items} items, ${n.events} events, ${n.notifications} notification records, ${n.productions} productions.`);
  const open = importer.gaps.filter((gap) => gap.open).sort((a, b) => GAP_CLASSES.indexOf(a.class) - GAP_CLASSES.indexOf(b.class) || Date.parse(a.actedAt) - Date.parse(b.actedAt) || a.place - b.place);
  out.push(`${c}: gaps, in the order to take them again:`);
  for (const [index, gap] of open.entries()) out.push(`${c}: ${index + 1}. ${gap.class}, ${gap.targetType ?? "no target"} ${gap.targetId ?? ""}`.trimEnd() + `, first done ${gap.actedAt}`);
  if (open.length === 0) out.push(`${c}: none.`);
  const site = open.filter((gap) => GAP_SITE_CLASSES.includes(gap.class)).length;
  out.push(
    site > 0
      ? `${c}: The app's site stays closed until gaps 1 to ${site} are closed on the console's After a restore screen.`
      : `${c}: No order disabling and no seal was lost: the app's site may open once the operator has read the rest.`,
  );
  out.push(`${c}: Not in these files: anything after ${lastAt ?? "the head"}, the keeper's last download. Compare the contact-point mailbox since then with the orders above; open what is missing with order-open.`);
  if (walked.hole !== null) out.push(`${c}: the files hold nothing between place ${walked.hole.after} and place ${walked.hole.before}: what happened there is not imported`);
  // 3d Task 8 (W.11, Restoring): one line a published version of an edition that the restored database lost.
  for (const lost of importer.editionsLost) {
    out.push(`${c}: edition ${lost.year} version ${lost.version}, published ${lost.at}, is not in the restored database: /transparency no longer shows it until the job publishes the year again (the README, Restoring).`);
  }
  return out;
}
```

```ts
  config,

  verify: verificationProviderFrom(config),
});

  apiDb,
  uploadsDir: config.MEDIA_UPLOADS_DIR,
  storeDir: config.MEDIA_STORE_DIR,
  formats: config.MEDIA_FORMATS,

  logger,
  requireSession: auth.requireSession,
  resolveSession: auth.resolveSession,
  rateLimitStore,
  enforceUploadLimit: (userId, accountCreatedAt, now) => enforceWriteLimit(rateLimitStore, userId, "upload", accountCreatedAt, now),
  // 3d Task 3: the edge's purge adapter (EDGE_PURGE, off by default); the configuration refused a test adapter on an open site.
  edge: edgeAdapterFrom(config),
  // 3d Task 6: the scorer's model whose scores finalize keeps: the test scorer's under R1_CLASSIFIER=test (refused on an open

  r1Model: config.R1_CLASSIFIER === "test" ? R1_TEST_MODEL : null,
  // 3d Task 7: the comparison with known material (MEDIA_MATCH, off by default); the configuration refused a test adapter

  match: matchAdapterFrom(config),
});

// Background work runs on one API instance at a time, under locks in Redis that are refreshed while a round runs.
const jobLock = redisJobLock(redis);
const stopSweeper = media.startSweeper(jobLock);
// 3d Task 3: the edge's outbox, drained every fifteen seconds: closed as off while the adapter is off, else one purge a round.
const stopEdge = media.startEdge(jobLock);
// 3d Task 7: match-retry, a round a minute: asks again for checks that were not answered or met the limit on refusals.
const stopMatch = media.startMatchRetry(jobLock);
const stopJanitor = auth.startJanitor(jobLock);
// 3d Task 4: the public figures. The module is built once auth exists, and auth is handed its count afterwards, as the
// wiring hands the media module its handler: resolveSession then counts the month's signed-in accounts and, while
// RECIPIENTS_SIGNED_OUT is on, each day's signed-out readers. Its job closes a month's count and, once a day after the
// dispatch hour, publishes what edition is due. 3d Task 5: and the audit head's daily value, witnessed while HEAD_WITNESS
// is on and mailed to the keeper through the auth module's one sender to HEAD_KEEPER_MAIL.
const transparency = createTransparency({ apiDb, redis, auth: auth.forTransparency, config, logger });
auth.onSeen(transparency.forAuth);
const stopTransparency = transparency.startJobs(jobLock);

// Moderation cases: the module owns its tables on the API's role and reaches the social module through an interface of
// that module's own, built over the same pool, the image rows through the media module's interface for cases, and a
// notifier's contact and every mail through the auth module's. Its limits count in the store the per-IP limit uses, and
// the routes of an account's own decisions and reports stand behind the auth module's session guard.
const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: media.forCases, requireSession: auth.requireSession, rateLimitStore, config, logger });
// The dispatch job: the staff alerts that are still due, the daily release of outcomes, and the mails that waited. And the
// retention job: what is due is erased, and kept image rows nothing retains go; while MODERATION_RETENTION is off it only

media.onMatch(moderation.matched);

const social = createSocial({
  apiDb,
  rateLimitStore,
  logger,
  requireSession: auth.requireSession,
  requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(),
  media: media.forPosts,
  // The chip on the author's own withheld or removed post names its decision, which the moderation module reads.
  moderation: moderation.forSocial,
  // Profile and handle changes are security events; the social module hands them to the auth module, which owns the table.
  events: { append: auth.appendEvent },
});
// Explore's ranking: a round at once, so Explore is filled on a new database or after downtime, then one every five minutes.
const stopExplore = social.startExplore(jobLock);

// The account module owns no table: it reaches the three modules above only through the interfaces their index files export.
const account = createAccount({
  auth: auth.forAccount,
  social: social.forAccount,
  media: media.forAccount,
  // The purge forgets that the deleted account sent its reports, which the moderation module's tables hold.
  moderation: moderation.forAccount,
  requireSession: auth.requireSession,
  requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(),
  requireStrongFreshAuth: auth.requireStrongFreshAuth(),
  rateLimitStore,
  logger,
});
// Deletions the process did not finish (a crash after the auth step, a failed purge) are completed within five minutes.
const stopPurge = account.startPurge(jobLock);

// The staff console's API; createApp mounts it only while CONSOLE_ORIGIN is set. Its credential work is the auth module's,
// its case work the moderation module's.
const staff = createStaff({ apiDb, auth: auth.forStaff, moderation: moderation.forStaff });

const app = createApp({
  config,
  logger,
  rateLimitStore,
  healthChecks: {
    postgres_api: () => ping(apiDb),
    postgres_auth: () => ping(authDb),
    redis: async () => { await redis.ping(); },
  },
  advisoryChecks: { image_worker: media.healthCheck },
  auth,
  social,
  media,
  account,
  staff,
  moderation,
  transparency,
});

const server = serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: config.PORT, hostname: "0.0.0.0" }, (info) => {
  logger.info({ port: info.port, version: config.KORBAT_VERSION }, "api listening");
});

/** How long the shutdown waits for the moderation module's tasks that a request started and did not wait for. */
const SETTLE_MS = 5_000;

async function shutdown(signal: string) {
  logger.info({ signal }, "shutting down");
  stopSweeper();
  stopEdge();
  stopMatch();
  stopJanitor();
  stopTransparency();
  stopExplore();
  stopPurge();
  stopModeration();
  server.close();
  // A statement, a receipt or a staff alert may be on its way to the relay: it gets five seconds to finish before the
  // pools close under it. What is still unsent then stays pending, and the dispatch job of the next start sends it.
  let waited: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
  const settled = await Promise.race([
    moderation.settle().then(() => true),
    new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
      waited = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), SETTLE_MS);
    }),
  ]);
  clearTimeout(waited);
  if (!settled) logger.warn({ signal }, "shutting down with moderation mails still in flight; what is pending is sent after the next start");
  await Promise.allSettled([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), redis.quit()]);
  process.exit(0);
}
process.on("SIGTERM", () => void shutdown("SIGTERM"));
process.on("SIGINT", () => void shutdown("SIGINT"));
```

```ts
import type { EdgePurgeView, MatchRecord, MediaSize } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { VARIANTS } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import type { MediaDeps } from "./context";
import type { StoredFile } from "./files";
import { createMatchRepo, type MatchRepo, type OwnRefusal, type RefusalRow, type Runner } from "./match-repo";
import { owedLate, requestOwed } from "./owed";
import type { CaseReach, HeldImage, HoldPair } from "./repo";
import { RECONCILE_MAX_ORPHANS } from "./sweeper";
import { WEBP_HEADER_BYTES, webpSize } from "./webp";

 * MEDIA_RECONCILE=force. The files of a batch are requested after its commit; a batch notes inside its transaction that
 * they are owed, so a crash in between, or a request that cannot be written, loses nothing: the note is what the request
 * is written from later. Should the notes be lost as well (an uploads volume put back from an older copy), one batch's
 * files, with other deletions' lost in the same way, still stay within what one reconcile pass removes by itself (3c
 * design, section 5).
 */

  postId: string;
  file: StoredFile;

   * the case's evidence hold on them; a pair `{ ownerId }` only locks every image row on that account's posts, for a
   * report of child sexual abuse material about the account. All rows are locked by one statement, in one id order.
   * It answers each post pair's images in position order, for the post's snapshot; an empty list means they are gone.

   * file whose header says that it is a WebP of the size its variant and its row allow. 3d Task 7 (sections 5 and 7.11,
   * review ruling 2): never an image that an unerased match record names, an acting match or a flag, whatever its state and

  purges(mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<EdgePurgeView[]>;

  matchJoined(tx: Runner, matchId: string, caseId: string | null): Promise<void>;

  matchedImages(mediaIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Set<string>>;
  /** 3d Task 7 (7.12 step 1): one of the uploader's refusals, as its notice reads it; null for anyone else's. */
  refusalOf(ownerId: string, refusalId: string): Promise<OwnRefusal | null>;
  /** The uploader's refusals, newest first, after a cursor's (time, id), at most `limit`, each with its sort key. */
  refusalsOf(ownerId: string, after: { at: string; id: string } | null, limit: number): Promise<{ id: string; at: string; key: string }[]>;
  /**
   * 7.12 step 2: the one statement that writes an objection, under the rule the guard states; `not_open` when it changed
   * no row of the owner's, `not_found` for a refusal that is not theirs.
   */
  objectToRefusal(ownerId: string, refusalId: string, text: string): Promise<"objected" | "not_open" | "not_found">;
  /** The dispatch round's notices (7.14): the refusals whose notice is owed, and its outcome. */
  refusalsUntold(limit: number): Promise<{ id: string; ownerId: string | null; refusedAt: string }[]>;
  refusalTold(refusalId: string, outcome: "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "none" | "failed"): Promise<void>;
  /** The holds ended as no_report whose delay has passed and whose notice that the hold was lifted is owed, and its outcome. */
  liftedUntold(limit: number): Promise<{ id: string; ownerId: string | null; endedAt: string }[]>;
  liftedTold(refusalId: string, outcome: "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "none" | "failed"): Promise<void>;
  /** Held uploads (7.12 step 3): a page from `offset`, one row more than a page; and one refusal as the list shows it. */
  heldList(offset: number): Promise<RefusalRow[]>;
  held(refusalId: string): Promise<RefusalRow | null>;
  /** Home's [home.uploads] and the urgent alert's heldUploads (8.2, W.7). */
  heldOverview(): Promise<{ open: number; oldest: string | null; objected: number; capped: number }>;
  /** Home's [home.unreported]: the holds ended as no_report in the last `days` days, newest first. */
  recentUnreported(days: number, max: number): Promise<{ at: string; refusalId: string }[]>;
  /** The uploader and the image of a refusal, for the end's and the release's transactions. */
  refusalSubject(q: Runner, refusalId: string): Promise<{ ownerId: string | null; mediaId: string } | null>;
```
